title: The greatest surah in the Quran
en: While I was praying in the Mosque, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  called me but I did not respond to him. Later I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! I was praying." He said, "Didn't Allah say'--"Give your response to Allah (by obeying Him) and to His Messenger when he calls you." (8:24) He then said to me, "I will teach you a Sura which is the greatest Sura in the Qur'an, before you leave the Mosque." Then he got hold of my hand, and when he intended to leave (the Mosque), I said to him, "Didn't you say to me, 'I will teach you a Sura which is the greatest Sura in the Qur'an?' He said, "Al-Hamdu-Li l-lah Rabbi-l-`alamin (i.e. Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds) which is Al-Sab'a Al-Mathani (i.e. seven repeatedly recited Verses) and the Grand Qur'an which has been given to me."
ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي خُبَيْبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُعَلَّى، قَالَ كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَدَعَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ أُجِبْهُ، فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ يَقُلِ اللَّهُ ‏{‏اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ‏}‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي لأُعَلِّمَنَّكَ سُورَةً هِيَ أَعْظَمُ السُّوَرِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ بِيَدِي، فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَلَمْ تَقُلْ ‏"‏ لأُعَلِّمَنَّكَ سُورَةً هِيَ أَعْظَمُ سُورَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ‏{‏الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ‏}‏ هِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
note: Al-Fatihah is named the greatest surah and the 'seven oft-repeated verses'.
tl: Haddathana musaddadun, haddathana yahya, ʿan shuʿbata, qala haddathanee khubaybu bnu ʿabdi ar-rahmani, ʿan hafsi bni ʿasimin, ʿan abee saʿeedi bni al-muʿalla, qala kuntu usallee fee al-masjidi fadaʿanee rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama falam ujibhu, faqultu ya rasoola Allahi innee kuntu usallee. faqala " alam yaquli Allahu “istajeeboo lillahi walir-rasooli idha daʿakum” thumma qala lee l'uʿallimannaka sooratan hiya aʿzamu as-suwari fee al-qur'ani qabla an takhruja mina al-masjidi ". thumma akhadha biyadee, falamma arada an yakhruja qultu lahu alam taqul " l'uʿallimannaka sooratan hiya aʿzamu sooratin fee al-qur'ani ". qala " “al-hamdu lillahi rabbi al-ʿal-meena” hiya as-sabʿu al-mathanee wal-qur'anu al-ʿazeemu alladhee ooteetuhu ".

title: No prayer without Al-Fatihah
en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said, "Whoever does not recite Al-Fatiha in his prayer, his prayer is invalid."
ar: ‏ لاَ صَلاَةَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَقْرَأْ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ ‏
note: Why every Muslim recites Al-Fatihah in every unit (rak'ah) of prayer.
tl: La salata liman lam yaqra' bifatihati al-kitabi

title: The Mother of the Quran
en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said, "The Um (substance) of the Qur'an is the seven oft-repeated verses (Al- Mathaini) and is the Great Qur'an (i.e. Surat-al-Fatiha).
ar: ‏ أُمُّ الْقُرْآنِ هِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ ‏
note: Al-Fatihah is 'Umm al-Quran' and the seven oft-repeated verses of 15:87.
tl: Ummu al-qur'ani hiya as-sabʿu al-mathanee wal-qur'anu al-ʿazeemu

title: Satan flees from a house where Al-Baqarah is recited
narrator: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:
en: Do not make your houses as graveyards. Satan runs away from the house in which Surah Baqara is recited.
ar: ‏ لاَ تَجْعَلُوا بُيُوتَكُمْ مَقَابِرَ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَنْفِرُ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ الَّذِي تُقْرَأُ فِيهِ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ ‏
note: Encouragement to recite Al-Baqarah at home.
tl: La tajʿaloo buyootakum maqabira inna ash-shaytana yanfiru mina al-bayti alladhee tuqra'u feehi sooratu al-baqarati

title: The greatest verse: Ayat al-Kursi
en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Abu' al-Mundhir, do you know the verse from the Book of Allah which, according to you, is the greatest? I said: Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ) know best. He again said: Abu'l-Mundhir, do you know the verse from the Book of Allah which, according to you, is the greatest? I said: Allah, there is no god but He, the Living, the Eternal. Thereupon he struck me on my breast and said: May knowledge be pleasant for you, O Abu'l-Mundhir!
ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي السَّلِيلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ أَتَدْرِي أَىُّ آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مَعَكَ أَعْظَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ أَتَدْرِي أَىُّ آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مَعَكَ أَعْظَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّومُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَضَرَبَ فِي صَدْرِي وَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لِيَهْنِكَ الْعِلْمُ أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
note: The Prophet ﷺ praised Ubayy's knowledge when he named the Verse of the Throne.
tl: Haddathana aboo bakri bnu abee shaybata, haddathana ʿabdu al-aʿla bnu ʿabdi al-aʿla, ʿani al-jurayriyyi, ʿan abee as-saleeli, ʿan ʿabdi Allahi bni rabahin al-ansariyyi, ʿan uba bni kaʿbin, qala qala rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama " ya aba al-mundhiri atadree a ayatin min kitabi Allahi maʿaka aʿzamu ". qala qultu Allahu warasooluhu aʿlamu. qala " ya aba al-mundhiri atadree a ayatin min kitabi Allahi maʿaka aʿzamu ". qala qultu Allahu la ilaha ila huwa al-ha al-qayyoomu. qala fadaraba fee sadree waqala " wallahi liyahnika al-ʿilmu aba al-mundhiri ".

title: The last two verses of Al-Baqarah at night
en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If somebody recited the last two Verses of Surat Al-Baqara at night, that will be sufficient for him."
ar: ‏ مَنْ قَرَأَ بِالآيَتَيْنِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كَفَتَاهُ‏
note: Reciting the final two verses of Al-Baqarah at night is sufficient for the reciter.
tl: Man qara'a bil-ayatayni min akhiri soorati al-baqarati fee laylatin kafatahu

title: How the Companions received 2:284–286
narrator: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas:
en: When this verse:" Whether you disclose that which is in your mind or conceal it, Allah will call you to account according to it" (ii 284), there entered in their minds something (of that fear) such as had never entered their hearts (before). The Messenger (ﷺ) observed: Say: We have heard and obeyed and submitted ourselves. He (the reporter) said: Allah instilled faith in their hearts and He revealed this verse:" Allah burdens not a soul beyond its capacity. It gets every good that it earns and it suffers every ill that it earns. Our Lord, call us not to account if we forget or make a mistake. He the (Lord) said: I indeed did it. Our Lord! do not lay on us a burden as You didst lay on those before us. He (our Lord) said: I indeed did it. And pardon us, have mercy on us. You are our Protector" (ii. 286). He said: I indeed did it.
ar: ‏ قُولُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا وَسَلَّمْنَا ‏
note: The Companions' worry over a verse, their submission, and Allah's relief in the closing verses.
tl: Qooloo samiʿna waataʿna wasallamna

title: The two bright ones: Al-Baqarah and Ali 'Imran
narrator: Abu Umama said he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say:
en: Recite the Qur'an, for on the Day of Resurrection it will come as an intercessor for those who recite It. Recite the two bright ones, al-Baqara and Surah Al 'Imran, for on the Day of Resurrection they will come as two clouds or two shades, or two flocks of birds in ranks, pleading for those who recite them. Recite Surah al-Baqara, for to take recourse to it is a blessing and to give it up is a cause of grief, and the magicians cannot confront it. (Mu'awiya said: It has been conveyed to me that here Batala means magicians.)
ar: ‏ اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شَفِيعًا لأَصْحَابِهِ اقْرَءُوا الزَّهْرَاوَيْنِ الْبَقَرَةَ وَسُورَةَ آلِ عِمْرَانَ فَإِنَّهُمَا تَأْتِيَانِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَأَنَّهُمَا غَمَامَتَانِ أَوْ كَأَنَّهُمَا غَيَايَتَانِ أَوْ كَأَنَّهُمَا فِرْقَانِ مِنْ طَيْرٍ صَوَافَّ تُحَاجَّانِ عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِمَا اقْرَءُوا سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ فَإِنَّ أَخْذَهَا بَرَكَةٌ وَتَرْكَهَا حَسْرَةٌ وَلاَ تَسْتَطِيعُهَا الْبَطَلَةُ ‏
note: These two surahs will come as shade for their companions on the Day of Resurrection.
tl: Iqra'oo al-qur'ana fainnahu ya'tee yawma al-qiyamati shafeeʿan l'ashabihi iqra'oo az-zahrawayni al-baqarata wasoorata ali ʿimrana fainnahuma ta'tiyani yawma al-qiyamati ka'annahuma ghamamatani aw ka'annahuma ghayayatani aw ka'annahuma firqani min tayrin sawaffa tuhajjani ʿan ashabihima iqra'oo soorata al-baqarati fainna akhdhaha barakatun watarkaha hasratun wala tastateeʿuha al-batalatu

title: Reflecting at night: 'In the creation of the heavens…'
en: I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt Maimuna. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  talked with his wife for a while and then went to bed. When it was the last third of the night, he got up and looked towards the sky and said: "Verily! In the creation of the Heavens and the Earth and in the alteration of night and day, there are indeed signs for men of understanding." (3:190) Then he stood up, performed ablution, brushed his teeth with a Siwak, and then prayed eleven rak`at. Then Bilal pronounced the Adhan (i.e. call for the Fajr prayer). The Prophet (ﷺ) then offered two rak`at (Sunna) prayer and went out (to the Mosque) and offered the (compulsory congregational) Fajr prayer.
ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ، فَتَحَدَّثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ أَهْلِهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ رَقَدَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرُ قَعَدَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏{‏إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لآيَاتٍ لأُولِي الأَلْبَابِ‏}‏، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَتَوَضَّأَ وَاسْتَنَّ، فَصَلَّى إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ بِلاَلٌ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ‏.‏
note: The Prophet ﷺ recited these verses looking at the sky in the last third of the night.
tl: Haddathana saʿeedu bnu abee maryama, akhbarana muhammadu bnu jaʿfarin, qala akhbaranee shareeku bnu ʿabdi Allahi bni abee namirin, ʿan kuraybin, ʿani ibni ʿabbasin radiya Allahu ʿanhuma qala bittu ʿinda khal-tee maymoonata, fatahaddatha rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama maʿa ahlihi saʿatan thumma raqada, falamma kana thuluthu al-layli al-akhiru qaʿada fanazara ila as-sama'i faqala “inna fee khalqi as-samawati wal-ardi wakhtilafi al-layli wan-nahari l'ayatin l'oolee al-albabi”, thumma qama fatawadda'a wastanna, fasalla ihda ʿashrata rakʿatan, thumma adhdhana bilalun fasalla rakʿatayni, thumma kharaja fasalla as-subha.

title: 'Allah is sufficient for us'
en: 'Allah is Sufficient for us and He Is the Best Disposer of affairs," was said by Abraham when he was thrown into the fire; and it was said by Muhammad when they (i.e. hypocrites) said, "A great army is gathering against you, therefore, fear them," but it only increased their faith and they said: "Allah is Sufficient for us, and He is the Best Disposer (of affairs, for us)." (3:173)
ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ ـ أُرَاهُ قَالَ ـ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، ‏{‏حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ‏}‏ قَالَهَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ حِينَ أُلْقِيَ فِي النَّارِ، وَقَالَهَا مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ قَالُوا ‏{‏إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَقَالُوا حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ‏}‏
note: The words said by Ibrahim in the fire and by the Prophet ﷺ when threatened.
tl: Haddathana ahmadu bnu yoonusa urahu qala haddathana aboo bakrin, ʿan abee haseenin, ʿan abee ad-duha, ʿani ibni ʿabbasin, “hasbuna Allahu waniʿma al-wakeelu” qal-ha ibraheemu ʿalayhi as-salamu heena ulqiya fee an-nari, waqal-ha muhammadun salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama heena qal-wa “inna an-nasa qad jamaʿoo lakum fakhshawhum fazadahum eemanan waqal-wa hasbuna Allahu waniʿma al-wakeelu”

title: The Prophet ﷺ wept at Surah An-Nisa
en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said to me, "Recite (of the Qur'an) for me," I said, "Shall I recite it to you although it had been revealed to you?" He said, "I like to hear (the Qur'an) from others." So I recited Surat-an- Nisa' till I reached: "How (will it be) then when We bring from each nation a witness, and We bring you (O Muhammad) as a witness against these people?" (4:41) Then he said, "Stop!" And behold, his eyes were overflowing with tears."
ar: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ يَحْيَى بَعْضُ الْحَدِيثِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ عَلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ آقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَيْكَ أُنْزِلَ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَسْمَعَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةَ النِّسَاءِ حَتَّى بَلَغْتُ ‏{‏فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ شَهِيدًا‏}‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْسِكْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَإِذَا عَيْنَاهُ تَذْرِفَانِ‏.‏
note: Ibn Mas'ud recited to the Prophet ﷺ, who wept at the verse about witnesses.
tl: Haddathana sadaqatu, akhbarana yahya, ʿan sufyana, ʿan sulaymana, ʿan ibraheema, ʿan ʿabeedata, ʿan ʿabdi Allahi, qala yahya baʿdu al-hadeethi ʿan ʿamri bni murrata, qala qala lee an-nabiyyu salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama " iqra' ʿala ". qultu aqra'u ʿalayka waʿalayka unzila qala " fainnee uhibbu an asmaʿahu min ghayree ". faqara'tu ʿalayhi soorata an-nisa'i hatta balaghtu “fakayfa idha ji'na min kulli ummatin bishaheedin waji'na bika ʿala ha'ula'i shaheedan” qala " amsik ". faidha ʿaynahu tadhrifani.

title: 'Today I have perfected your religion'
en: Once a Jew said to me, "O the chief of believers! There is a verse in your Holy Book Which is read by all of you (Muslims), and had it been revealed to us, we would have taken that day (on which it was revealed as a day of celebration." 'Umar bin Al-Khattab asked, "Which is that verse?" The Jew replied, "This day I have perfected your religion For you, completed My favor upon you, And have chosen for you Islam as your religion." (5:3) 'Umar replied,"No doubt, we know when and where this verse was revealed to the Prophet. It was Friday and the Prophet (ﷺ) was standing at 'Arafat (i.e. the Day of Hajj)"
ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، سَمِعَ جَعْفَرَ بْنَ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْعُمَيْسِ، أَخْبَرَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الْيَهُودِ قَالَ لَهُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، آيَةٌ فِي كِتَابِكُمْ تَقْرَءُونَهَا لَوْ عَلَيْنَا مَعْشَرَ الْيَهُودِ نَزَلَتْ لاَتَّخَذْنَا ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ عِيدًا‏.‏ قَالَ أَىُّ آيَةٍ قَالَ ‏{‏الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ الإِسْلاَمَ دِينًا‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ قَدْ عَرَفْنَا ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ وَالْمَكَانَ الَّذِي نَزَلَتْ فِيهِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ بِعَرَفَةَ يَوْمَ جُمُعَةٍ‏.‏
note: 'Umar recalls the day and place this verse was revealed: 'Arafah, on a Friday.
tl: Haddathana al-hasanu bnu as-sabbahi, samiʿa jaʿfara bna ʿawnin, haddathana aboo al-ʿumaysi, akhbarana qaysu bnu muslimin, ʿan tariqi bni shihabin, ʿan ʿumara bni al-khattabi, anna rajulan, mina al-yahoodi qala lahu ya ameera al-mu'mineena, ayatun fee kitabikum taqra'oonaha law ʿalayna maʿshara al-yahoodi nazalat lattakhadhna dhalika al-yawma ʿeedan. qala a ayatin qala “al-yawma akmaltu lakum deenakum waatmamtu ʿalaykum niʿmatee waradeetu lakumu al-islama deenan”. qala ʿumaru qad ʿarafna dhalika al-yawma wal-makana alladhee nazalat feehi ʿala an-nabiyyi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama wahuwa qa'imun biʿarafata yawma jumuʿatin.

title: Wrongdoing in 6:82 means shirk
en: When the following Verse was revealed: "It is those who believe and confuse not their belief with wrong (worshipping others besides Allah.)" (6:83), the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  asked, "Who is amongst us who had not done injustice (wrong)?" Allah revealed: "No doubt, joining others in worship with Allah is a great injustice (wrong) indeed." (31:13)
ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتِ ‏{‏الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوا إِيمَانَهُمْ بِظُلْمٍ‏}‏ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيُّنَا لَمْ يَظْلِمْ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ‏}‏‏.‏
note: The Prophet ﷺ explained a verse with another verse, Luqman's advice to his son.
tl: Haddathana aboo al-waleedi, qala haddathana shuʿbatu, h. qala wahaddathanee bishrun, qala haddathana muhammadun, ʿan shuʿbata, ʿan sulaymana, ʿan ibraheema, ʿan ʿalqamata, ʿan ʿabdi Allahi, qala lamma nazalati “alladheena amanoo walam yalbisoo eemanahum bizulmin” qala ashabu rasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama ayyuna lam yazlim faanzala Allahu “inna ash-shirka lazulmun ʿazeemun”.

title: 'Shirk is a great injustice'
en: When the Verse:-- 'Those who believe and mix not their belief with wrong.' was revealed, the Muslims felt it very hard on them and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! Who amongst us does not do wrong to himself?" He replied, "The Verse does not mean this. But that (wrong) means to associate others in worship to Allah: Don't you listen to what Luqman said to his son when he was advising him," O my son! Join not others in worship with Allah. Verily joining others in worship with Allah is a great wrong indeed." (31:13)
ar: ‏ لَيْسَ ذَلِكَ، إِنَّمَا هُوَ الشِّرْكُ، أَلَمْ تَسْمَعُوا مَا قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لاِبْنِهِ وَهْوَ يَعِظُهُ ‏{‏يَا بُنَىَّ لاَ تُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ ‏}‏‏
note: Luqman's words explain what 'wrong' means in Surah Al-An'am.
tl: Laysa dhalika, innama huwa ash-shirku, alam tasmaʿoo ma qala luqmanu labnihi wahwa yaʿizuhu “ya buna la tushrik billahi inna ash-shirka lazulmun ʿazeemun ”

title: Answer the call of Allah and His Messenger
en: While I was praying, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  passed me and called me, but I did not go to him until I had finished the prayer. Then I went to him, and he said, "What prevented you from coming to me? Didn't Allah say:-- "O you who believe! Answer the call of Allah (by obeying Him) and His Messenger when He calls you?" He then said, "I will inform you of the greatest Sura in the Qur'an before I leave (the mosque)." When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  got ready to leave (the mosque), I reminded him. He said, "It is: 'Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.' (i.e. Surat-al-Fatiha) As-sab'a Al-Mathani (the seven repeatedly recited Verses).
ar: ‏ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ أَلَمْ يَقُلِ اللَّهُ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ‏}‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لأُعَلِّمَنَّكَ أَعْظَمَ سُورَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ ‏
note: A Companion learns to answer the Prophet's ﷺ call, and is taught the greatest surah.
tl: Ma manaʿaka an ta'tiya alam yaquli Allahu “ya ayyuha alladheena amanoo istajeeboo lillahi walir-rasooli idha daʿakum” thumma qala l'uʿallimannaka aʿzama sooratin fee al-qur'ani qabla an akhruja

title: 'Hud and its sisters have made me grey'
narrator: Abu Ishaq narrated from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas who said:
en: “Abu Bakr [may Allah be pleased with him] said: ‘O Messenger of Allah! You have become gray.’ He said: ‘I have gone gray from (Surat) Hud, Al-Waqi`ah, Al-Mursalat and `Amma Yatasa'alun and Idhash-Shamsu Kuwwirat.’”
ar: ‏ شَيَّبَتْنِي هُودٌ وَالْوَاقِعَةُ وَالْمُرْسَلاَتُ وَ عمَّ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ وَإذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ ‏
note: The weight of these surahs' descriptions of the Last Day.
tl: Shayyabatnee hoodun wal-waqiʿatu wal-mursalatu wa ʿmma yatasa'aloona wadha ash-shamsu kuwwirat

title: The most honourable of people
en: Some people asked the Prophet: "Who is the most honorable amongst the people?" He replied, "The most honorable among them is the one who is the most Allah-fearing." They said, "O Allah's Prophet! We do not ask about this." He said, "Then the most honorable person is Joseph, Allah's Prophet, the son of Allah's Prophet, the son of Allah's Prophet, the son of Allah's Khalil." They said, "We do not ask about this." He said, "Then you want to ask me about the Arabs' descent?" They said, "Yes." He said, "Those who were best in the pre-lslamic period, are the best in Islam, if they comprehend (the religious knowledge).
ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، سَمِعَ الْمُعْتَمِرَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قِيلَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْ أَكْرَمُ النَّاسِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَكْرَمُهُمْ أَتْقَاهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، لَيْسَ عَنْ هَذَا نَسْأَلُكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَكْرَمُ النَّاسِ يُوسُفُ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ ابْنُ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ ابْنِ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ ابْنِ خَلِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لَيْسَ عَنْ هَذَا نَسْأَلُكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَعَنْ مَعَادِنِ الْعَرَبِ تَسْأَلُونِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَخِيَارُكُمْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ خِيَارُكُمْ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ إِذَا فَقِهُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
note: The Prophet ﷺ names Yusuf, a prophet son of prophets, after God-consciousness.
tl: Haddathana ishaqu bnu ibraheema, samiʿa al-muʿtamira, ʿan ʿubaydi Allahi, ʿan saʿeedi bni abee saʿeedin al-maqburiyyi, ʿan abee hurayrata radiya Allahu ʿanhu qala qeela lin-nabiyyi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama man akramu an-nasi qala " akramuhum atqahum ". qal-wa ya nabiyya Allahi, laysa ʿan hadha nas'aluka. qala " faakramu an-nasi yoosufu nabiyyu Allahi ibnu nabiyyi Allahi ibni nabiyyi Allahi ibni khaleeli Allahi ". qal-wa laysa ʿan hadha nas'aluka. qala " faʿan maʿadini al-ʿarabi tas'aloonee ". qal-wa naʿam. qala " fakhiyarukum fee al-jahiliyyati khiyarukum fee al-islami idha faqihoo ".

title: The good word is like a palm tree
en: While we were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  he said, "Tell me of a tree which resembles a Muslim man. Its leaves do not fall and it does not, and does not, and does not, and it gives its fruits every now and then." It came to my mind that such a tree must be the date palm, but seeing Abu Bakr and `Umar saying nothing, I disliked to speak. So when they did not say anything, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said, "It is the date-palm tree." When we got up (from that place), I said to `Umar, "O my father! By Allah, it came to my mind that it must be the date palm tree." `Umar said, "What prevented you from speaking" I replied, "I did not see you speaking, so I misliked to speak or say anything." `Umar then said, "If you had said it, it would have been dearer to me than so-and-so."
ar: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَخْبِرُونِي بِشَجَرَةٍ تُشْبِهُ أَوْ كَالرَّجُلِ الْمُسْلِمِ لاَ يَتَحَاتُّ وَرَقُهَا وَلاَ وَلاَ وَلاَ، تُؤْتِي أُكْلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَوَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَّهَا النَّخْلَةُ، وَرَأَيْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ لاَ يَتَكَلَّمَانِ، فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ، فَلَمَّا لَمْ يَقُولُوا شَيْئًا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قُمْنَا قُلْتُ لِعُمَرَ يَا أَبَتَاهُ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ كَانَ وَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَّهَا النَّخْلَةُ فَقَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَكَلَّمَ قَالَ لَمْ أَرَكُمْ تَكَلَّمُونَ، فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ أَوْ أَقُولَ شَيْئًا‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ لأَنْ تَكُونَ قُلْتَهَا أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏
note: The believer is like the palm tree whose leaves do not fall.
tl: Haddathanee ʿubaydu bnu ismaʿeela, ʿan abee usamata, ʿan ʿubaydi Allahi, ʿan nafiʿin, ʿani ibni ʿumara radiya Allahu ʿanhuma qala kunna ʿinda rasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama faqala " akhbiroonee bishajaratin tushbihu aw kar-rajuli al-muslimi la yatahattu waraquha wala wala wala, tu'tee uklaha kulla heenin ". qala ibnu ʿumara fawaqaʿa fee nafsee annaha an-nakhlatu, wara'aytu aba bakrin waʿumara la yatakallamani, fakarihtu an atakallama, falamma lam yaqooloo shay'an qala rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama " hiya an-nakhlatu ". falamma qumna qultu liʿumara ya abatahu wallahi laqad kana waqaʿa fee nafsee annaha an-nakhlatu faqala ma manaʿaka an takallama qala lam arakum takallamoona, fakarihtu an atakallama aw aqoola shay'an. qala ʿumaru l'an takoona qultaha ahabbu ila min kadha wakadha.

title: Firmness in the grave
en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said, "When a Muslim is questioned in his grave, he will testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , and that is what is meant by Allah's Statement:-- "Allah will keep firm those who believe with a Word that stands firm in this world and in the Hereafter." (14:27)
ar: ‏ الْمُسْلِمُ إِذَا سُئِلَ فِي الْقَبْرِ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ ‏{‏يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الآخِرَةِ‏}‏‏
note: This verse refers to the believer's answer when questioned in the grave.
tl: Al-muslimu idha su'ila fee al-qabri yashhadu an la ilaha ila Allahu waanna muhammadan rasoolu Allahi, fadhalika qawluhu “yuthabbitu Allahu alladheena amanoo bil-qawli ath-thabiti fee al-hayati ad-dunya wafee al-akhirati”

title: Neither too loud nor too quiet
en: (regarding): 'Neither say your, prayer aloud, nor say it in a low tone.' (17:110) This Verse was revealed while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  was hiding himself in Mecca. When he prayed with his companions, he used to raise his voice with the recitation of Qur'an, and if the pagans happened to hear him, they would abuse the Qur'an, the One who revealed it and the one who brought it. Therefore Allah said to His Prophet (ﷺ) : 'Neither say your prayer aloud.' (17:110) i.e. do not recite aloud lest the pagans should hear you, but follow a way between.
ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُخْتَفٍ بِمَكَّةَ، كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى بِأَصْحَابِهِ رَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ بِالْقُرْآنِ فَإِذَا سَمِعَهُ الْمُشْرِكُونَ سَبُّوا الْقُرْآنَ وَمَنْ أَنْزَلَهُ، وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِهِ، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ‏}‏ أَىْ بِقِرَاءَتِكَ، فَيَسْمَعَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ، فَيَسُبُّوا الْقُرْآنَ، ‏{‏وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}‏ عَنْ أَصْحَابِكَ فَلاَ تُسْمِعُهُمْ ‏{‏وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ سَبِيلاً‏}‏‏.‏
note: Revealed while the Prophet ﷺ was hiding in Makkah.
tl: Haddathana yaʿqoobu bnu ibraheema, haddathana hushaymun, haddathana aboo bishrin, ʿan saʿeedi bni jubayrin, ʿani ibni ʿabbasin radiya Allahu ʿanhuma fee qawlihi taʿal-a “wala tajhar bisalatika wala tukhafit biha” qala nazalat warasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama mukhtafin bimakkata, kana idha salla biashabihi rafaʿa sawtahu bil-qur'ani faidha samiʿahu al-mushrikoona sabboo al-qur'ana waman anzalahu, waman ja'a bihi, faqala Allahu taʿal-a linabiyyihi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama “wala tajhar bisalatika” a biqira'atika, fayasmaʿa al-mushrikoona, fayasubboo al-qur'ana, “wala tukhafit biha” ʿan ashabika fala tusmiʿuhum “wabtaghi bayna dhalika sabeelan”.

title: The question about the spirit
en: While I was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a farm and he was reclining on a palm leave stalk, some Jews passed by. Some of them said to the others. "Ask him (the Prophet (ﷺ) about the spirit." Some of them said, "What urges you to ask him about it" Others said, "(Don't) lest he should give you a reply which you dislike." But they said, "Ask him." So they asked him about the Spirit. The Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet and did not give them any answer. I knew that he was being divinely inspired so I stayed at my place. When the divine inspiration had been revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) said. "They ask you (O, Muhammad) concerning the Spirit, Say: "The spirit," its knowledge is with my Lord; and of knowledge you (mankind) have been given only a Little." (17:85)
ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَرْثٍ وَهْوَ مُتَّكِئٌ عَلَى عَسِيبٍ إِذْ مَرَّ الْيَهُودُ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ سَلُوهُ عَنِ الرُّوحِ، فَقَالَ مَا رَابَكُمْ إِلَيْهِ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لاَ يَسْتَقْبِلُكُمْ بِشَىْءٍ تَكْرَهُونَهُ فَقَالُوا سَلُوهُ فَسَأَلُوهُ عَنِ الرُّوحِ فَأَمْسَكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ شَيْئًا، فَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ يُوحَى إِلَيْهِ، فَقُمْتُ مَقَامِي، فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ الْوَحْىُ قَالَ ‏{‏وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً‏}‏‏.‏
note: When asked about the ruh, the answer came: 'Of knowledge you have been given only a little.'
tl: Haddathana ʿumaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyathin, haddathana abee, haddathana al-aʿmashu, qala haddathanee ibraheemu, ʿan ʿalqamata, ʿan ʿabdi Allahi radiya Allahu ʿanhu qala bayna ana maʿa an-nabiyyi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama fee harthin wahwa muttaki'un ʿala ʿaseebin idh marra al-yahoodu, faqala baʿduhum libaʿdin saloohu ʿani ar-roohi, faqala ma rabakum ilayhi, waqala baʿduhum la yastaqbilukum bisha'in takrahoonahu faqal-wa saloohu fasa'aloohu ʿani ar-roohi faamsaka an-nabiyyu salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama falam yarudda ʿalayhim shay'an, faʿalimtu annahu yooha ilayhi, faqumtu maqamee, falamma nazala al-waha qala “wayas'aloonaka ʿani ar-roohi quli ar-roohu min amri rabbee wama ooteetum mina al-ʿilmi ila qaleelan”.

title: Ibn Mas'ud's earliest treasures
en: Surat Bani-lsrael, Al-Kahf (The Cave), Maryam, Taha, Al-Anbiya' (The prophets) are amongst my first earnings and my old property, and (in fact) they are my old property.
ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، يَقُولُ فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَالْكَهْفِ وَمَرْيَمَ وَطَهَ وَالأَنْبِيَاءِ إِنَّهُنَّ مِنَ الْعِتَاقِ الأُوَلِ وَهُنَّ مِنْ تِلاَدِي‏.‏
note: Five Makkan surahs that a great Companion cherished from the earliest days.
tl: Haddathana adamu, haddathana shuʿbatu, ʿan abee ishaqa, qala samiʿtu ʿabda ar-rahmani bna yazeeda, samiʿtu ibna masʿoodin, yaqoolu fee banee isra'eela wal-kahfi wamaryama wataha wal-anbiya'i innahunna mina al-ʿitaqi al-uwali wahunna min tiladee.

title: The first ten verses of Al-Kahf
narrator: Abu Darda' reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:
en: If anyone learns by heart the first ten verses of the Surah al-Kahf, he will be protected from the Dajjal.
ar: ‏ مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ ‏
note: Memorising them brings protection from the Dajjal.
tl: Man hafiza ʿashra ayatin min awwali soorati al-kahfi ʿusima mina ad-dajjali

title: Those who give while their hearts fear
narrator: Narrated 'Abdur-Rahman bin [Sa'eed bin] Wahb - that is Al-Hamdani:
en: that 'Aishah the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "I asked about the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about this Ayah: And those who give that which they give with their hearts full of fear... (23:60)" 'Aishah said: "Are they those who drink Khamr and steal?" He said: "No, O daughter of As-Siddiq. They are those who fast, perform Salat, give charity while they fear that their Lord will not accept it from them: It is these who hasten to do good deeds, and they are the foremost of them (23:61)."
ar: ‏ لاَ يَا بِنْتَ الصِّدِّيقِ وَلَكِنَّهُمُ الَّذِينَ يَصُومُونَ وَيُصَلُّونَ وَيَتَصَدَّقُونَ وَهُمْ يَخَافُونَ أَنْ لاَ يُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ ‏
note: 'A'ishah learned that this verse describes the devout, not the sinful.
tl: La ya binta as-siddeeqi walakinnahumu alladheena yasoomoona wayusalloona wayatasaddaqoona wahum yakhafoona an la yuqbala minhum oola'ika alladheena yusariʿoona fee al-khayrati wahum laha sabiqoona

title: The greatest sins
en: I or somebody, asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  "Which is the biggest sin in the Sight of Allah?" He said, "That you set up a rival (in worship) to Allah though He Alone created you." I asked, "What is next?" He said, "Then, that you kill your son, being afraid that he may share your meals with you." I asked, "What is next?" He said, "That you commit illegal sexual intercourse with the wife of your neighbor." Then the following Verse was revealed to confirm the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) : "Those who invoke not with Allah, any other god, nor kill life as Allah has forbidden except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse." (25:68)
ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورٌ، وَسُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي وَاصِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ـ أَوْ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ أَىُّ الذَّنْبِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِلَّهِ نِدًّا وَهْوَ خَلَقَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَنْ تَقْتُلَ وَلَدَكَ خَشْيَةَ أَنْ يَطْعَمَ مَعَكَ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تُزَانِيَ بِحَلِيلَةِ جَارِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ تَصْدِيقًا لِقَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ وَلاَ يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ‏}‏
note: The Prophet ﷺ named the gravest sins, and this verse was revealed confirming them.
tl: Haddathana musaddadun, haddathana yahya, ʿan sufyana, qala haddathanee mansoorun, wasulaymanu, ʿan abee wailin, ʿan abee maysarata, ʿan ʿabdi Allahi,. qala wahaddathanee wasilun, ʿan abee wailin, ʿan ʿabdi Allahi radiya Allahu ʿanhu qala sa'altu aw su'ila rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama a adh-dhanbi ʿinda Allahi akbaru qala " an tajʿala lillahi niddan wahwa khalaqaka ". qultu thumma a qala " thumma an taqtula waladaka khashyata an yatʿama maʿaka". qultu thumma a qala " an tuzaniya bihaleelati jarika ". qala wanazalat hadhihi al-ayatu tasdeeqan liqawli rasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama “walladheena la yadʿoona maʿa Allahi ilahan akhara wala yaqtuloona an-nafsa allatee harrama Allahu ila bil-haqqi wala yaznoona”

title: Ibrahim's prayer: 'Do not disgrace me'
en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Abraham will meet his father (on the Day of Resurrection) and will say, 'O my Lords You promised me that You would not let me in disgrace on the Day when people will be resurrected.' Allah will say, 'I have forbidden Paradise to the non-believers."
ar: ‏ يَلْقَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَبَاهُ فَيَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّكَ وَعَدْتَنِي أَنْ لاَ تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ إِنِّي حَرَّمْتُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ ‏
note: On the Day of Judgment Ibrahim will remind Allah of the prayer in 26:87.
tl: Yalqa ibraheemu abahu fayaqoolu ya rabbi innaka waʿadtanee an la tukhzinee yawma yubʿathoona fayaqoolu Allahu innee harramtu al-jannata ʿala al-kafireena

title: The call from Mount Safa
en: When the Verse:--'And warn your tribe of near-kindred, was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) ascended the Safa (mountain) and started calling, "O Bani Fihr! O Bani `Adi!" addressing various tribes of Quraish till they were assembled. Those who could not come themselves, sent their messengers to see what was there. Abu Lahab and other people from Quraish came and the Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Suppose I told you that there is an (enemy) cavalry in the valley intending to attack you, would you believe me?" They said, "Yes, for we have not found you telling anything other than the truth." He then said, "I am a warner to you in face of a terrific punishment." Abu Lahab said (to the Prophet) "May your hands perish all this day. Is it for this purpose you have gathered us?" Then it was revealed: "Perish the hands of Abu Lahab (one of the Prophet's uncles), and perish he! His wealth and his children will not profit him...." (111:1-5)
ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏ صَعِدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الصَّفَا فَجَعَلَ يُنَادِي ‏"‏ يَا بَنِي فِهْرٍ، يَا بَنِي عَدِيٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ لِبُطُونِ قُرَيْشٍ حَتَّى اجْتَمَعُوا، فَجَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولاً لِيَنْظُرَ مَا هُوَ، فَجَاءَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ وَقُرَيْشٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ لَوْ أَخْبَرْتُكُمْ أَنَّ خَيْلاً بِالْوَادِي تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُغِيرَ عَلَيْكُمْ، أَكُنْتُمْ مُصَدِّقِيَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ، مَا جَرَّبْنَا عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ صِدْقًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي نَذِيرٌ لَكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ تَبًّا لَكَ سَائِرَ الْيَوْمِ، أَلِهَذَا جَمَعْتَنَا فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ * مَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ‏}‏
note: Verse 214 begins the public call to Islam. Abu Lahab's curse brought Surah Al-Masad.
tl: Haddathana ʿumaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyathin, haddathana abee, haddathana al-aʿmashu, qala haddathanee ʿamroo bnu murrata, ʿan saʿeedi bni jubayrin, ʿani ibni ʿabbasin radiya Allahu ʿanhuma qala lamma nazalat “waandhir ʿasheerataka al-aqrabeena” saʿida an-nabiyyu salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama ʿala as-safa fajaʿala yunadee " ya banee fihrin, ya banee ʿadiyyin ". libutooni qurayshin hatta ijtamaʿoo, fajaʿala ar-rajulu idha lam yastatiʿ an yakhruja arsala rasoolan liyanzura ma huwa, faja'a aboo lahabin waqurayshun faqala " ara'aytakum law akhbartukum anna khaylan bil-wadee tureedu an tugheera ʿalaykum, akuntum musaddiqiyya ". qal-wa naʿam, ma jarrabna ʿalayka ila sidqan. qala " fainnee nadheerun lakum bayna yada ʿadhabin shadeedin ". faqala aboo lahabin tabban laka sa'ira al-yawmi, alihadha jamaʿtana fanazalat “tabbat yada abee lahabin watabba * ma aghna ʿanhu mal-hu wama kasaba”

title: 'Save yourselves from the Fire'
en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  got up when the Verse:--'And warn your tribe of near kindred...." (26:214) was revealed and said, "O Quraish people! (or he said a similar word) Buy yourselves! I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him) O Bani Abu Manaf! I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him). O `Abbas! The son of `Abdul Muttalib! I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him) O Safiya, (the aunt of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him). O Fatima, the daughter of Muhammad ! Ask what you wish from my property, but I cannot save you from Allah (if you disobey Him).
ar: ‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ قُرَيْشٍ ـ أَوْ كَلِمَةً نَحْوَهَا ـ اشْتَرُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، يَا عَبَّاسُ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، وَيَا صَفِيَّةُ عَمَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَيَا فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَلِينِي مَا شِئْتِ مِنْ مَالِي، لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا ‏
note: The Prophet ﷺ warned each clan, even his aunt Safiyyah and his daughter Fatimah.
tl: Ya maʿshara qurayshin aw kalimatan nahwaha ishtaroo anfusakum, la ughnee ʿankum mina Allahi shay'an, ya banee ʿabdi manafin, la ughnee ʿankum mina Allahi shay'an, ya ʿabbasu bna ʿabdi al-muttalibi, la ughnee ʿanka mina Allahi shay'an, waya safiyyatu ʿammata rasooli Allahi, la ughnee ʿanki mina Allahi shay'an waya fatimatu binta muhammadin saleenee ma shi'ti min mal-y, la ughnee ʿanki mina Allahi shay'an

title: 'O Fatimah, rescue yourself from the Fire'
en: When this verse was revealed:" And warn your nearest kindred (al-Qur'an, xxvi. 214), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called the Quraish; so they gathered and he gave them a general warning. Then he made a particular (reference to certain tribes) and said: O sons of Ka'b b. Luwayy, rescue yourselves from the Fire; O sons of Murra b. Ka'b, rescue yourselves from the Fire: O sons of Abd Shams, rescue yourselves from the Fire; 0 sons of Abd Manaf rescue yourselves from the Fire; O sons of Hashim, rescue yourselves from the Fire; 0 sons of Abd al-Muttalib, rescue yourselves from the Fire; O Fatimah, rescue thyself from the Fire, for I have no power (to protect you) from Allah in anything except this that I would sustain relationship with you.
ar: ‏ يَا بَنِي كَعْبِ بْنِ لُؤَىٍّ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا بَنِي مُرَّةَ بْنِ كَعْبٍ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ شَمْسٍ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا بَنِي هَاشِمٍ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا فَاطِمَةُ أَنْقِذِي نَفْسَكِ مِنَ النَّارِ فَإِنِّي لاَ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا غَيْرَ أَنَّ لَكُمْ رَحِمًا سَأَبُلُّهَا بِبَلاَلِهَا ‏
note: Kinship to a prophet does not save anyone; only faith and deeds do.
tl: Ya banee kaʿbi bni lu'a anqidhoo anfusakum mina an-nari ya banee murrata bni kaʿbin anqidhoo anfusakum mina an-nari ya banee ʿabdi shamsin anqidhoo anfusakum mina an-nari ya banee ʿabdi manafin anqidhoo anfusakum mina an-nari ya banee hashimin anqidhoo anfusakum mina an-nari ya banee ʿabdi al-muttalibi anqidhoo anfusakum mina an-nari ya fatimatu anqidhee nafsaki mina an-nari fainnee la amliku lakum mina Allahi shay'an ghayra anna lakum rahiman sa'abulluha bibalaliha

title: The death of Abu Talib
en: When Abu Talib was on his death bed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  came to him and found with him, Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya bin Al-Mughira. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said, "O uncle! Say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, a sentence with which I will defend you before Allah." On that Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya said to Abu Talib, "Will you now leave the religion of `Abdul Muttalib?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  kept on inviting him to say that sentence while the other two kept on repeating their sentence before him till Abu Talib said as the last thing he said to them, "I am on the religion of `Abdul Muttalib," and refused to say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said, "By Allah, I will keep on asking Allah's forgiveness for you unless I am forbidden (by Allah) to do so." So Allah revealed:-- 'It is not fitting for the Prophet (ﷺ) and those who believe that they should invoke (Allah) for forgiveness for pagans.' (9:113) And then Allah revealed especially about Abu Talib:--'Verily! You (O, Muhammad) guide not whom you like, but Allah guides whom He will.' (28:56)
ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا حَضَرَتْ أَبَا طَالِبٍ الْوَفَاةُ جَاءَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهِ أَبَا جَهْلٍ وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَىْ عَمِّ قُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، كَلِمَةً أُحَاجُّ لَكَ بِهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ أَتَرْغَبُ عَنْ مِلَّةِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْرِضُهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَيُعِيدَانِهِ بِتِلْكَ الْمَقَالَةِ حَتَّى قَالَ أَبُو طَالِبٍ آخِرَ مَا كَلَّمَهُمْ عَلَى مِلَّةِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، وَأَبَى أَنْ يَقُولُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ مَا لَمْ أُنْهَ عَنْكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوا لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ‏}‏ وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِي أَبِي طَالِبٍ، فَقَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏إِنَّكَ لاَ تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏{‏أُولِي الْقُوَّةِ‏}‏ لاَ يَرْفَعُهَا الْعُصْبَةُ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ‏.‏ ‏{‏لَتَنُوءُ‏}‏ لَتُثْقِلُ‏.‏ ‏{‏فَارِغًا‏}‏ إِلاَّ مِنْ ذِكْرِ مُوسَى‏.‏ ‏{‏الْفَرِحِينَ‏}‏ الْمَرِحِينَ‏.‏ ‏{‏قُصِّيهِ‏}‏ اتَّبِعِي أَثَرَهُ، وَقَدْ يَكُونُ أَنْ يَقُصَّ الْكَلاَمَ ‏{‏نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ‏}‏‏.‏ ‏{‏عَنْ جُنُبٍ‏}‏ عَنْ بُعْدٍ عَنْ جَنَابَةٍ وَاحِدٌ، وَعَنِ اجْتِنَابٍ أَيْضًا، يَبْطِشُ وَيَبْطُشُ‏.‏ ‏{‏يَأْتَمِرُونَ‏}‏ يَتَشَاوَرُونَ‏.‏ الْعُدْوَانُ وَالْعَدَاءُ وَالتَّعَدِّي وَاحِدٌ‏.‏ ‏{‏آنَسَ‏}‏ أَبْصَرَ‏.‏ الْجِذْوَةُ قِطْعَةٌ غَلِيظَةٌ مِنَ الْخَشَبِ، لَيْسَ فِيهَا لَهَبٌ، وَالشِّهَابُ فِيهِ لَهَبٌ‏.‏ وَالْحَيَّاتُ أَجْنَاسٌ الْجَانُّ وَالأَفَاعِي وَالأَسَاوِدُ‏.‏ ‏{‏رِدْءًا‏}‏ مُعِينًا‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏{‏يُصَدِّقُنِي‏}‏ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ ‏{‏سَنَشُدُّ‏}‏ سَنُعِينُكَ كُلَّمَا عَزَّزْتَ شَيْئًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْتَ لَهُ عَضُدًا‏.‏ مَقْبُوحِينَ مُهْلَكِينَ‏.‏ ‏{‏وَصَّلْنَا‏}‏ بَيَّنَّاهُ وَأَتْمَمْنَاهُ‏.‏ ‏{‏يُجْبَى‏}‏ يُجْلَبُ ‏.‏‏{‏بَطِرَتْ‏}‏ أَشِرَتْ‏.‏ ‏{‏فِي أُمِّهَا رَسُولاً‏}‏ أُمُّ الْقُرَى مَكَّةُ وَمَا حَوْلَهَا‏.‏ ‏{‏تُكِنُّ‏}‏ تُخْفِي‏.‏ أَكْنَنْتُ الشَّىْءَ أَخْفَيْتُهُ، وَكَنَنْتُهُ أَخْفَيْتُهُ وَأَظْهَرْتُهُ‏.‏ ‏{‏وَيْكَأَنَّ اللَّهَ‏}‏ مِثْلُ أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ ‏{‏يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ‏}‏ يُوَسِّعُ عَلَيْهِ وَيُضَيِّقُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
note: 'You cannot guide whom you love': revealed about the Prophet's ﷺ beloved uncle.
tl: Haddathana aboo al-yamani, akhbarana shuʿaybun, ʿani az-zuhriyyi, qala akhbaranee saʿeedu bnu al-musayyabi, ʿan abeehi, qala lamma hadarat aba tal-bin al-wafatu ja'ahu rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama fawajada ʿindahi aba jahlin waʿabda Allahi bna abee umayyata bni al-mugheerati, faqala " a ʿammi qul la ilaha ila Allahu, kalimatan uhajju laka biha ʿinda Allahi ". faqala aboo jahlin waʿabdu Allahi bnu abee umayyata atarghabu ʿan millati ʿabdi al-muttalibi falam yazal rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama yaʿriduha ʿalayhi, wayuʿeedanihi bitilka al-maqal-ti hatta qala aboo tal-bin akhira ma kallamahum ʿala millati ʿabdi al-muttalibi, waaba an yaqoolu la ilaha ila Allahu. qala qala rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama " wallahi l'astaghfiranna laka ma lam unha ʿanka ". faanzala Allahu “ma kana lin-nabiyyi walladheena amanoo an yastaghfiroo lilmushrikeena” waanzala Allahu fee abee tal-bin, faqala lirasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama “innaka la tahdee man ahbabta walakinna Allaha yahdee man yasha'u”. qala ibnu ʿabbasin “oolee al-quwwati” la yarfaʿuha al-ʿusbatu mina ar-rijali. “latanoo'u” latuthqilu. “farighan” ila min dhikri moosa. “al-fariheena” al-mariheena. “qusseehi” ittabiʿee atharahu, waqad yakoonu an yaqussa al-kalama “nahnu naqussu ʿalayka”. “ʿan junubin” ʿan buʿdin ʿan janabatin wahidun, waʿani ijtinabin aydan, yabtishu wayabtushu. “ya'tamiroona” yatashawaroona. al-ʿudwanu wal-ʿada'u wat-taʿaddee wahidun. “anasa” absara. al-jidhwatu qitʿatun ghaleezatun mina al-khashabi, laysa feeha lahabun, wash-shihabu feehi lahabun. wal-hayyatu ajnasun al-jannu wal-afaʿee wal-asawidu. “rid'an” muʿeenan. qala ibnu ʿabbasin “yusaddiqunee” waqala ghayruhu “sanashuddu” sanuʿeenuka kullama ʿazzazta shay'an faqad jaʿalta lahu ʿadudan. maqbooheena muhlakeena. “wassalna” bayyannahu waatmamnahu. “yujba” yujlabu.“batirat” ashirat. “fee ummiha rasoolan” ummu al-qura makkatu wama hawlaha. “tukinnu” tukhfee. aknantu ash-sha'a akhfaytuhu, wakanantuhu akhfaytuhu waazhartuhu. “wayka'anna Allaha” mithlu alam tara anna Allaha “yabsutu ar-rizqa liman yasha'u wayaqdiru” yuwassiʿu ʿalayhi wayudayyiqu ʿalayhi.

title: The Romans defeated, then victorious
en: from Ibn 'Abbas, regarding the saying of Allah, Most High: Alif Lam Mim. The Romans have been defeated. In the nearest land (30:1-3)" he said: "Ghulibat wa Ghalabat (defeated and then victorious)." He said: "The idolaters wanted the Persians to be victorious over the Romans because they too were people who worshiped idols, while the Muslims wanted the Romans to be victorious over the Persians because they were people of the Book. This was mentioned to Abu Bakr, so Abu Bakr mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: 'They will certainly prevail.' Abu Bakr mentioned that to them, and they said: 'Make a wager between us and you; if we win, we shall get this and that, and if you win, you shall get this or that.' He made the term five years, but they (the Romans) were not victorious. They mentioned that to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said: "Why did you not make it less (than)" - He (one of the narrators said): I think he said: "ten?" He said: Sa'eed said: "Al-Bid' is what is less than then" - he said: "Afterwards the Romans have been victorious." He said: "That is what Allah Most High said: 'Alif Lam Mim. The Romans have been defeated' up to His saying: 'And on the day, the believers will rejoice - with the help of Allah. He helps whom He wills (30:1-5).' Sufyan said: "I heard that they were victorious over them on the Day of Badr."
ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ حُرَيْثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيِّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏:‏ ‏(‏ الم * غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ * فِي أَدْنَى الأَرْضِ ‏)‏ قَالَ غُلِبَتْ وَغَلَبَتْ كَانَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ يُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَظْهَرَ أَهْلُ فَارِسَ عَلَى الرُّومِ لأَنَّهُمْ وَإِيَّاهُمْ أَهْلُ أَوْثَانٍ وَكَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ يُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَظْهَرَ الرُّومُ عَلَى فَارِسَ لأَنَّهُمْ أَهْلُ كِتَابٍ فَذَكَرُوهُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ فَذَكَرَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا إِنَّهُمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لَهُمْ فَقَالُوا اجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ أَجَلاً فَإِنْ ظَهَرْنَا كَانَ لَنَا كَذَا وَكَذَا وَإِنْ ظَهَرْتُمْ كَانَ لَكُمْ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَجَعَلَ أَجَلَ خَمْسِ سِنِينَ فَلَمْ يَظْهَرُوا فَذَكَرُوا ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ جَعَلْتَهُ إِلَى دُونِ - قَالَ أُرَاهُ الْعَشْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعِيدٌ وَالْبِضْعُ مَا دُونَ الْعَشْرِ قَالَ ثُمَّ ظَهَرَتِ الرُّومُ بَعْدُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى ‏:‏ ‏(‏ الم * غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ ‏)‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏:‏ ‏(‏يفْرَحُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ * بِنَصْرِ اللَّهِ يَنْصُرُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ‏)‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ سَمِعْتُ أَنَّهُمْ ظَهَرُوا عَلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ غَرِيبٌ إِنَّمَا نَعْرِفُهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ ‏.‏
note: A prophecy of Byzantine victory that came true within a few years.
tl: Haddathana al-husaynu bnu huraythin, haddathana muʿawiyatu bnu ʿamrin, ʿan abee ishaqa al-fazariyyi, ʿan sufyana ath-thawriyyi, ʿan habeebi bni abee ʿamrata, ʿan saʿeedi bni jubayrin, ʿani ibni ʿabbasin, fee qawli Allahi taʿal-a : ( al-m * ghulibati ar-roomu * fee adna al-ardi ) qala ghulibat waghalabat kana al-mushrikoona yuhibboona an yazhara ahlu farisa ʿala ar-roomi l'annahum waiyyahum ahlu awthanin wakana al-muslimoona yuhibboona an yazhara ar-roomu ʿala farisa l'annahum ahlu kitabin fadhakaroohu l'abee bakrin fadhakarahu aboo bakrin lirasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama qala " ama innahum sayaghliboona ". fadhakarahu aboo bakrin lahum faqal-wa ijʿal baynana wabaynaka ajalan fain zaharna kana lana kadha wakadha wain zahartum kana lakum kadha wakadha fajaʿala ajala khamsi sineena falam yazharoo fadhakaroo dhalika lin-nabiyyi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama faqala " ala jaʿaltahu ila dooni - qala urahu al-ʿashri ". qala saʿeedun wal-bidʿu ma doona al-ʿashri qala thumma zaharati ar-roomu baʿdu. qala fadhalika qawluhu taʿal-a : ( al-m * ghulibati ar-roomu ) ila qawlihi : (yfrahu al-mu'minoona * binasri Allahi yansuru man yasha'u ) qala sufyanu samiʿtu annahum zaharoo ʿalayhim yawma badrin. qala aboo ʿeesa hadha hadeethun hasanun saheehun ghareebun innama naʿrifuhu min hadeethi sufyana ath-thawriyyi ʿan habeebi bni abee ʿamrata.

title: Friday dawn prayer recitation
en: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the following in the Fajr prayer of Friday, "Alif, Lam, Mim, Tanzil" (Suratas- Sajda #32) and "Hal-ata-ala-l-Insani" (i.e. Surah-Ad-Dahr #76).
ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ هُرْمُزَ ـ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ ‏{‏الم * تَنْزِيلُ‏}‏ السَّجْدَةَ وَ‏{‏هَلْ أَتَى عَلَى الإِنْسَانِ‏}‏
note: The Prophet ﷺ recited As-Sajdah and Al-Insan in Fajr on Fridays.
tl: Haddathana aboo nuʿaymin, qala haddathana sufyanu, ʿan saʿdi bni ibraheema, ʿan ʿabdi ar-rahmani huwa ibnu hurmuza ʿan abee hurayrata radiya Allahu ʿanhu qala kana an-nabiyyu salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama yaqra'u fee al-jumuʿati fee salati al-fajri “al-m * tanzeelu” as-sajdata wa“hal ata ʿala al-insani”

title: How to send blessings on the Prophet ﷺ
en: It was said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! We know how to greet you, but how to invoke Allah for you?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Say: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa'ala `Ali Muhammaddin, kama sallaita 'ala all Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid."
ar: ‏ قُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ ‏
note: The Prophet ﷺ taught the Ibrahimic salawat recited in every prayer.
tl: Qooloo Allaha salli ʿala muhammadin waʿala ali muhammadin, kama sallayta ʿala ali ibraheema, innaka hameedun majeedun, Allaha barik ʿala muhammadin waʿala ali muhammadin, kama barakta ʿala ali ibraheema, innaka hameedun majeedun

title: When Allah decrees a matter in heaven
en: Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When Allah decrees some order in the heaven, the angels flutter their wings indicating complete surrender to His saying which sounds like chains being dragged on rock. And when the state of fear disappears, they ask each other, "What has your Lord ordered? They say that He has said that which is true and just, and He is the Most High, the Most Great." (34:23). Then the stealthy listeners (devils) hear this order, and these stealthy listeners are like this, one over the other." (Sufyan, a sub-narrator demonstrated that by holding his hand upright and separating the fingers.) A stealthy listener hears a word which he will convey to that which is below him and the second will convey it to that which is below him till the last of them will convey it to the wizard or foreteller. Sometimes a flame (fire) may strike the devil before he can convey it, and sometimes he may convey it before the flame (fire) strikes him, whereupon the wizard adds to that word a hundred lies. The people will then say, 'Didn't he (i.e. magician) tell such-and-such a thing on such-and-such date?' So that magician is said to have told the truth because of the Statement which has been heard from the heavens."
ar: ‏ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ الأَمْرَ فِي السَّمَاءِ ضَرَبَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بِأَجْنِحَتِهَا خُضْعَانًا لِقَوْلِهِ كَأَنَّهُ سِلْسِلَةٌ عَلَى صَفْوَانٍ فَإِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ، قَالُوا لِلَّذِي قَالَ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ فَيَسْمَعُهَا مُسْتَرِقُ السَّمْعِ، وَمُسْتَرِقُ السَّمْعِ هَكَذَا بَعْضُهُ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ ـ وَوَصَفَ سُفْيَانُ بِكَفِّهِ فَحَرَفَهَا وَبَدَّدَ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ ـ فَيَسْمَعُ الْكَلِمَةَ، فَيُلْقِيهَا إِلَى مَنْ تَحْتَهُ ثُمَّ يُلْقِيهَا الآخَرُ إِلَى مَنْ تَحْتَهُ، حَتَّى يُلْقِيَهَا عَلَى لِسَانِ السَّاحِرِ أَوِ الْكَاهِنِ، فَرُبَّمَا أَدْرَكَ الشِّهَابُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُلْقِيَهَا، وَرُبَّمَا أَلْقَاهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْرِكَهُ، فَيَكْذِبُ مَعَهَا مِائَةَ كَذْبَةٍ، فَيُقَالُ أَلَيْسَ قَدْ قَالَ لَنَا يَوْمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا كَذَا وَكَذَا فَيُصَدَّقُ بِتِلْكَ الْكَلِمَةِ الَّتِي سَمِعَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ ‏
note: The angels' awe at Allah's word, explaining 34:23.
tl: Idha qada Allahu al-amra fee as-sama'i darabati al-mala'ikatu biajnihatiha khudʿanan liqawlihi ka'annahu silsilatun ʿala safwanin faidha fuzziʿa ʿan quloobihim qal-wa madha qala rabbukum, qal-wa lilladhee qala al-haqqa wahuwa al-ʿaliyyu al-kabeeru fayasmaʿuha mustariqu as-samʿi, wamustariqu as-samʿi hakadha baʿduhu fawqa baʿdin wawasafa sufyanu bikaffihi faharafaha wabaddada bayna asabiʿihi fayasmaʿu al-kalimata, fayulqeeha ila man tahtahu thumma yulqeeha al-akharu ila man tahtahu, hatta yulqiyaha ʿala lisani as-sahiri awi al-kahini, farubbama adraka ash-shihabu qabla an yulqiyaha, warubbama alqaha qabla an yudrikahu, fayakdhibu maʿaha mi'ata kadhbatin, fayuqalu alaysa qad qala lana yawma kadha wakadha kadha wakadha fayusaddaqu bitilka al-kalimati allatee samiʿa mina as-sama'i

title: The prostration in Surah Sad
en: The prostration of Sa`d is not a compulsory one but I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrating while reciting it.
ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ ‏{‏ص‏}‏ لَيْسَ مِنْ عَزَائِمِ السُّجُودِ، وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْجُدُ فِيهَا‏.‏
note: Ibn 'Abbas saw the Prophet ﷺ prostrate when reciting it.
tl: Haddathana sulaymanu bnu harbin, waaboo an-nuʿmani, qal- haddathana hammadun, ʿan ayyooba, ʿan ʿikrimata, ʿani ibni ʿabbasin radiya Allahu ʿanhuma qala “s” laysa min ʿaza'imi as-sujoodi, waqad ra'aytu an-nabiyya salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama yasjudu feeha.

title: The heavens on a finger
en: A (Jewish) Rabbi came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  and he said, "O Muhammad! We learn that Allah will put all the heavens on one finger, and the earths on one finger, and the trees on one finger, and the water and the dust on one finger, and all the other created beings on one finger. Then He will say, 'I am the King.' Thereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) smiled so that his pre-molar teeth became visible, and that was the confirmation of the Rabbi. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  recited: 'They made not a just estimate of Allah such as is due to Him. And on the Day of Resurrection the whole of the earth will be grasped by His Hand and the heavens will be rolled up in His Right Hand. Glorified is He, and High is He above all that they associate as partners with Him.' (39:67)
ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَ حَبْرٌ مِنَ الأَحْبَارِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ، إِنَّا نَجِدُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلُ السَّمَوَاتِ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ وَالأَرَضِينَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، وَالشَّجَرَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، وَالْمَاءَ وَالثَّرَى عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، وَسَائِرَ الْخَلاَئِقِ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ، فَيَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ‏.‏ فَضَحِكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى بَدَتْ نَوَاجِذُهُ تَصْدِيقًا لِقَوْلِ الْحَبْرِ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَالسَّمَوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ‏}‏
note: A rabbi's statement that the Prophet ﷺ confirmed by reciting 39:67.
tl: Haddathana adamu, haddathana shaybanu, ʿan mansoorin, ʿan ibraheema, ʿan ʿabeedata, ʿan ʿabdi Allahi radiya Allahu ʿanhu qala ja'a habrun mina al-ahbari ila rasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama faqala ya muhammadu, inna najidu anna Allaha yajʿalu as-samawati ʿala isbaʿin wal-aradeena ʿala isbaʿin, wash-shajara ʿala isbaʿin, wal-ma'a wath-thara ʿala isbaʿin, wasa'ira al-khala'iqi ʿala isbaʿin, fayaqoolu ana al-maliku. fadahika an-nabiyyu salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama hatta badat nawajidhuhu tasdeeqan liqawli al-habri thumma qara'a rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama “wama qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi wal-ardu jameeʿan qabdatuhu yawma al-qiyamati was-samawatu matwiyyatun biyameenihi subhanahu wataʿal-a ʿamma yushrikoona”

title: Do you think Allah hears?
en: There gathered near the House (i.e. the Ka`ba) two Quraishi persons and a person from Thaqif (or two persons from Thaqif and one from Quraish), and all of them with very fat bellies but very little intelligence. One of them said, "Do you think that Allah hears what we say?" Another said, "He hears us when we talk in a loud voice, but He doesn't hear us when we talk in a low tone." The third said, "If He can hear when we talk in a loud tone, then He can also hear when we speak in a low tone." Then Allah, the Honorable, the Majestic revealed: 'And you have not been screening against yourself lest your ears, and eyes and your skins should testify against you....' (41:22-23) This hadith has been narrated through another chain as well.
ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ اجْتَمَعَ عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ قُرَشِيَّانِ وَثَقَفِيٌّ ـ أَوْ ثَقَفِيَّانِ وَقُرَشِيٌّ ـ كَثِيرَةٌ شَحْمُ بُطُونِهِمْ قَلِيلَةٌ فِقْهُ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمْ أَتُرَوْنَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَسْمَعُ مَا نَقُولُ قَالَ الآخَرُ يَسْمَعُ إِنْ جَهَرْنَا وَلاَ يَسْمَعُ إِنْ أَخْفَيْنَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ إِنْ كَانَ يَسْمَعُ إِذَا جَهَرْنَا فَإِنَّهُ يَسْمَعُ إِذَا أَخْفَيْنَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلاَ أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلاَ جُلُودُكُمْ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏ وَكَانَ سُفْيَانُ يُحَدِّثُنَا بِهَذَا فَيَقُولُ حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ أَوِ ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ أَوْ حُمَيْدٌ أَحَدُهُمْ أَوِ اثْنَانِ مِنْهُمْ، ثُمَّ ثَبَتَ عَلَى مَنْصُورٍ، وَتَرَكَ ذَلِكَ مِرَارًا غَيْرَ وَاحِدَةٍ‏.‏
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بِنَحْوِهِ‏.‏
note: Revealed about men at the Ka'bah who doubted that Allah hears secret talk.
tl: Haddathana al-humaydiyyu, haddathana sufyanu, haddathana mansoorun, ʿan mujahidin, ʿan abee maʿmarin, ʿan ʿabdi Allahi radiya Allahu ʿanhu qala ijtamaʿa ʿinda al-bayti qurashiyyani wathaqafiyyun aw thaqafiyyani waqurashiyyun katheeratun shahmu butoonihim qaleelatun fiqhu quloobihim faqala ahaduhum aturawna anna Allaha yasmaʿu ma naqoolu qala al-akharu yasmaʿu in jaharna wala yasmaʿu in akhfayna. waqala al-akharu in kana yasmaʿu idha jaharna fainnahu yasmaʿu idha akhfayna faanzala Allahu ʿazza wajalla “wama kuntum tastatiroona an yashhada ʿalaykum samʿukum wala absarukum wala juloodukum” al-ayata. wakana sufyanu yuhaddithuna bihadha fayaqoolu haddathana mansoorun awi ibnu abee najeehin aw humaydun ahaduhum awi ithnani minhum, thumma thabata ʿala mansoorin, wataraka dhalika miraran ghayra wahidatin. haddathana ʿamroo bnu ʿaliyyin, haddathana yahya, haddathana sufyanu ath-thawriyyu, qala haddathanee mansoorun, ʿan mujahidin, ʿan abee maʿmarin, ʿan ʿabdi Allahi, binahwihi.

title: Love for kinship
en: That he was asked (regarding): "Except to be kind to me for my Kinship with you.' (42:23) Sa`id bin Zubair (who was present then) said, "It means here (to show what is due for) the relatives of Muhammad." On that Ibn `Abbas said: you have hurried in giving the answer! There was no branch of the tribe of Quraish but the Prophet (ﷺ) had relatives therein. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I do not want anything from (you ) except to be Kind to me for my Kinship with you."
ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ طَاوُسًا، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ‏.‏ أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏إِلاَّ الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبَى‏}‏ فَقَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ قُرْبَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ عَجِلْتَ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَكُنْ بَطْنٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ إِلاَّ كَانَ لَهُ فِيهِمْ قَرَابَةٌ فَقَالَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَصِلُوا مَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ مِنَ الْقَرَابَةِ‏.‏
note: Ibn 'Abbas explains the meaning of 42:23.
tl: Haddathana muhammadu bnu bashsharin, haddathana muhammadu bnu jaʿfarin, haddathana shuʿbatu, ʿan ʿabdi al-maliki bni maysarata, qala samiʿtu tawusan, ʿani ibni ʿabbasin radiya Allahu ʿanhuma. annahu su'ila ʿan qawlihi “ila al-mawaddata fee al-qurba” faqala saʿeedu bnu jubayrin qurba ali muhammadin salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama faqala ibnu ʿabbasin ʿajilta inna an-nabiyya salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama lam yakun batnun min qurayshin ila kana lahu feehim qarabatun faqala ila an tasiloo ma baynee wabaynakum mina al-qarabati.

title: The smoke and the famine
en: It (i.e., the imagined smoke) was because, when the Quraish refused to obey the Prophet, he asked Allah to afflict them with years of famine similar to those of (Prophet) Joseph. So they were stricken with famine and fatigue, so much so that they ate even bones. A man would look towards the sky and imagine seeing something like smoke between him and the sky because of extreme fatigue. So Allah revealed:-- 'Then watch you for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible, covering the people; this is a painfull of torment.' (44:10-11) Then someone (Abu Sufyan) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! Invoke Allah to send rain for the tribes of Mudar for they are on the verge of destruction." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said (astonishingly) "Shall I invoke Allah) for the tribes of Mudar? Verily, you are a brave man!" But the Prophet (ﷺ) prayed for rain and it rained for them. Then the Verse was revealed. 'But truly you will return (to disbelief).' (44:15) (When the famine was over and) they restored prosperity and welfare, they reverted to their ways (of heathenism) whereupon Allah revealed: 'On the Day when We shall seize you with a Mighty Grasp. We will indeed (then) exact retribution.' (44:16) The narrator said, "That was the day of the Battle of Badr."
ar: ‏ لِمُضَرَ إِنَّكَ لَجَرِيءٌ ‏
note: Ibn Mas'ud explains the 'smoke' in Surah Ad-Dukhan.
tl: Limudara innaka lajaree'un

title: Do not curse time
en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said, "Allah said, 'The son of Adam hurts me for he abuses Time though I am Time: in My Hands are all things, and I cause the revolution of day and night.'
ar: ‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يُؤْذِينِي ابْنُ آدَمَ، يَسُبُّ الدَّهْرَ وَأَنَا الدَّهْرُ، بِيَدِي الأَمْرُ، أُقَلِّبُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ‏
note: A hadith qudsi: Allah controls night and day.
tl: Qala Allahu ʿazza wajalla yu'dheenee ibnu adama, yasubbu ad-dahra waana ad-dahru, biyadee al-amru, uqallibu al-layla wan-nahara

title: The Prophet's ﷺ fear at the sight of clouds
en: `Aisha said If the Prophet (ﷺ) saw a cloud In the sky, he would walk to and fro in agitation, go out and come in, and the color of his face would change, and if it rained, he would feel relaxed." So `Aisha knew that state of his. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said, I don't know (am afraid), it may be similar to what happened to some people referred to in the Holy Qur'an in the following Verse: -- "Then when they saw it as a dense cloud coming towards their valleys, they said, 'This is a cloud bringing us rain!' Nay, but, it is that (torment) which you were asking to be hastened a wind wherein is severe torment." (46:24)
ar: ‏ مَا أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ كَمَا قَالَ قَوْمٌ ‏{‏فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ‏}‏ ‏
note: He remembered the people of 'Ad, who thought a punishing cloud would bring rain.
tl: Ma adree laʿallahu kama qala qawmun “falamma ra'awhu ʿaridan mustaqbila awdiyatihim”

title: The womb holds the Throne
en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah created His creation, and when He had finished it, the womb, got up and caught hold of Allah whereupon Allah said, "What is the matter?' On that, it said, 'I seek refuge with you from those who sever the ties of Kith and kin.' On that Allah said, 'Will you be satisfied if I bestow My favors on him who keeps your ties, and withhold My favors from him who severs your ties?' On that it said, 'Yes, O my Lord!' Then Allah said, 'That is for you.' " Abu Huraira added: If you wish, you can recite: "Would you then if you were given the authority. do mischief in the land and sever your ties of kinship. (47. 22)
ar: ‏ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْهُ قَامَتِ الرَّحِمُ فَأَخَذَتْ بِحَقْوِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَقَالَ لَهَا مَهْ‏.‏ قَالَتْ هَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ الْقَطِيعَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلاَ تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ وَأَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ بَلَى يَا رَبِّ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَاكِ لَكِ ‏
note: On keeping and cutting ties of kinship.
tl: Khalaqa Allahu al-khalqa, falamma faragha minhu qamati ar-rahimu faakhadhat bihaqwi ar-rahmani faqala laha mah. qal-t hadha maqamu al-ʿa'idhi bika mina al-qateeʿati. qala ala tardayna an asila man wasalaki waaqtaʿa man qataʿaki. qal-t bala ya rabbi. qala fadhaki laki

title: A surah dearer than all the world
en: While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  was proceeding at night during one of his journeys and `Umar bin Al-Khattab was traveling beside him, `Umar asked him about something but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  did not reply. He asked again, but he did not reply, and then he asked (for the third time) but he did not reply. On that, `Umar bin Al-Khattab said to himself, "Thakilat Ummu `Umar (May `Umar's mother lose her son)! I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  three times but he did not reply." `Umar then said, "I made my camel run faster and went ahead of the people, and I was afraid that some Qur'anic Verses might be revealed about me. But before getting involved in any other matter. I heard somebody calling me. I said to myself, 'I fear that some Qur'anic Verses have been revealed about me,' and so I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  and greeted him. He (Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  ) said, 'Tonight a Sura has been revealed to me, and it is dearer to me than that on which the sun rises (i.e. the world)' Then he recited: "Verily, We have given you a manifest victory." (48:1)
ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَسِيرُ فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ وَعُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَسِيرُ مَعَهُ لَيْلاً، فَسَأَلَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ شَىْءٍ، فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فُلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ثَكِلَتْ أُمُّ عُمَرَ، نَزَرْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، كُلَّ ذَلِكَ لاَ يُجِيبُكَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَحَرَّكْتُ بَعِيرِي، ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمْتُ أَمَامَ النَّاسِ، وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ يُنْزَلَ فِيَّ الْقُرْآنُ، فَمَا نَشِبْتُ أَنْ سَمِعْتُ صَارِخًا يَصْرُخُ بِي فَقُلْتُ لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ نَزَلَ فِيَّ قُرْآنٌ‏.‏ فَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَىَّ اللَّيْلَةَ سُورَةٌ لَهِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏"‏‏{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا‏}‏‏"‏
note: Surah Al-Fath was revealed on the way back from Hudaybiyah.
tl: Haddathana ʿabdu Allahi bnu maslamata, ʿan mal-kin, ʿan zaydi bni aslama, ʿan abeehi, anna rasoola Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama kana yaseeru fee baʿdi asfarihi waʿumaru bnu al-khattabi yaseeru maʿahu laylan, fasa'alahu ʿumaru bnu al-khattabi ʿan sha'in, falam yujibhu rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama thumma sa'alahu falam yujibhu, thumma sa'alahu fulam yujibhu, faqala ʿumaru bnu al-khattabi thakilat ummu ʿumara, nazarta rasoola Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama thalatha marratin, kulla dhalika la yujeebuka. qala ʿumaru faharraktu baʿeeree, thumma taqaddamtu amama an-nasi, wakhasheetu an yunzala fiyya al-qur'anu, fama nashibtu an samiʿtu sarikhan yasrukhu bee faqultu laqad khasheetu an yakoona nazala fiyya qur'anun. faji'tu rasoola Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama fasallamtu ʿalayhi faqala " laqad unzilat ʿala al-laylata sooratun lahiya ahabbu ila mimma talaʿat ʿalayhi ash-shamsu ". thumma qara'a "“inna fatahna laka fathan mubeenan”"

title: Thabit ibn Qays and the raised voice
en: The Prophet (ﷺ) missed Thabit bin Qais for a period (So he inquired about him). A man said. "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! I will bring you his news." So he went to Thabit and found him sitting in his house and bowing his head. The man said to Thabit, " 'What is the matter with you?" Thabit replied that it was an evil affair, for he used to raise his voice above the voice of the Prophet (ﷺ) and so all his good deeds had been annulled, and he considered himself as one of the people of the Fire. Then the man returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and told him that Thabit had said, so-and-so. (Musa bin Anas) said: The man returned to Thabit with great glad tidings. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the man. "Go back to him and say to him: "You are not from the people of the Hell Fire, but from the people of Paradise."
ar: ‏ اذْهَبْ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْ لَهُ إِنَّكَ لَسْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَلَكِنَّكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏
note: A Companion feared his loud voice had ruined his deeds; he was given glad tidings.
tl: Idhhab ilayhi faqul lahu innaka lasta min ahli an-nari, walakinnaka min ahli al-jannati

title: Learning Qaf from the Prophet's ﷺ sermons
narrator: Umm Bisham hint Haritha b. Nu'man said:
en: Our oven and that of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was one for two years, or for one year or for a part of a year; and I learnt" Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an" from no other source than the tongue of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who used to recite it every Friday on the pulpit when he delivered the sermon to the people.
ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ خُبَيْبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَعْنٍ عَنْ بِنْتٍ لِحَارِثَةَ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَتْ مَا حَفِظْتُ ‏{‏ ق‏}‏ إِلاَّ مِنْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ بِهَا كُلَّ جُمُعَةٍ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَكَانَ تَنُّورُنَا وَتَنُّورُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاحِدًا ‏.‏
note: He recited Surah Qaf from the pulpit every Friday.
tl: Haddathanee muhammadu bnu bashsharin, haddathana muhammadu bnu jaʿfarin, haddathana shuʿbatu, ʿan khubaybin, ʿan ʿabdi, Allahi bni muhammadi bni maʿnin ʿan bintin liharithata bni an-nuʿmani, qal-t ma hafiztu “ q” ila min fee rasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama yakhtubu biha kulla jumuʿatin. qal-t wakana tannooruna watannooru rasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama wahidan.

title: The verse that brought faith to Jubayr's heart
en: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Surat at-Tur in the Maghrib prayer, and when he reached the Verse: 'Were they created by nothing, Or were they themselves the creators, Or did they create the Heavens and the Earth? Nay, but they have no firm belief Or do they own the treasures of Your Lord? Or have they been given the authority to do as they like...' (52:35-37) my heart was about to fly (when I realized this firm argument).
ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثُونِي عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِالطُّورِ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏أَمْ خُلِقُوا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ * أَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ بَلْ لاَ يُوقِنُونَ * أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُسَيْطِرُونَ‏}‏ كَادَ قَلْبِي أَنْ يَطِيرَ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فَأَمَّا أَنَا فَإِنَّمَا سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِالطُّورِ‏.‏ لَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ زَادَ الَّذِي قَالُوا لِي‏.‏
note: A non-Muslim heard these verses in prayer and felt his heart almost fly.
tl: Haddathana al-humaydiyyu, haddathana sufyanu, qala haddathoonee ʿani az-zuhriyyi, ʿan muhammadi bni jubayri bni mutʿimin, ʿan abeehi radiya Allahu ʿanhu qala samiʿtu an-nabiyya salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama yaqra'u fee al-maghribi bit-toori falamma balagha hadhihi al-ayata “am khuliqoo min ghayri sha'in am humu al-khal-qoona * am khalaqoo as-samawati wal-arda bal la yooqinoona * am ʿindahum khaza'inu rabbika am humu al-musaytiroona” kada qalbee an yateera. qala sufyanu faamma ana fainnama samiʿtu az-zuhriyya yuhaddithu ʿan muhammadi bni jubayri bni mutʿimin ʿan abeehi samiʿtu an-nabiyya salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama yaqra'u fee al-maghribi bit-toori. lam asmaʿhu zada alladhee qal-wa lee.

title: Prostration at the end of An-Najm
en: The Prophet (ﷺ) recited Suratan-Najm (103) at Mecca and prostrated while reciting it and those who were with him did the same except an old man who took a handful of small stones or earth and lifted it to his forehead and said, "This is sufficient for me." Later on, I saw him killed as a non-believer.
ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الأَسْوَدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَرَأَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّجْمَ بِمَكَّةَ فَسَجَدَ فِيهَا، وَسَجَدَ مَنْ مَعَهُ، غَيْرَ شَيْخٍ أَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ حَصًى أَوْ تُرَابٍ فَرَفَعَهُ إِلَى جَبْهَتِهِ وَقَالَ يَكْفِينِي هَذَا‏.‏ فَرَأَيْتُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قُتِلَ كَافِرًا‏.‏
note: All present prostrated with the Prophet ﷺ in Makkah, except one old man.
tl: Haddathana muhammadu bnu bashsharin, qala haddathana ghundarun, qala haddathana shuʿbatu, ʿan abee ishaqa, qala samiʿtu al-aswada, ʿan ʿabdi Allahi radiya Allahu ʿanhu qala qara'a an-nabiyyu salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama an-najma bimakkata fasajada feeha, wasajada man maʿahu, ghayra shaykhin akhadha kaffan min hasana aw turabin farafaʿahu ila jabhatihi waqala yakfeenee hadha. fara'aytuhu baʿda dhalika qutila kafiran.

title: The splitting of the moon
en: During the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) the moon was split into two parts and on that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Bear witness (to thus).
ar: ‏ اشْهَدُوا ‏
note: A sign witnessed in Makkah during the Prophet's ﷺ lifetime.
tl: Ishhadoo

title: The jinn's response to Ar-Rahman
narrator: Muhammad bin Al Munkadir narrated that:
en: Jabir [may Allah be pleased with him] said: “The Messenger of Allah came out to his Companions, and recited Surat Ar-Rahman from its beginning to its end for them, and they were silent. So he said: ‘I recited it to the Jinns on the ‘Night of the Jinns,’ and they had a better response to it than you did. Each time I came to Allah’s saying: ‘Which of your Lords favor do you deny.’ They said: “We do not deny any of Your favors our Lord! And Yours is praise.”
ar: ‏ لَقَدْ قَرَأْتُهَا عَلَى الْجِنِّ لَيْلَةَ الْجِنِّ فَكَانُوا أَحْسَنَ مَرْدُودًا مِنْكُمْ كُنْتُ كُلَّمَا أَتَيْتُ عَلَى قَوْلِهِِ ‏:‏ ‏(‏ فبأَىِّ آلاَءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ‏)‏ قَالُوا لاَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ نِعَمِكَ رَبَّنَا نُكَذِّبُ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏
note: The jinn answered the repeated question better than the Companions did.
tl: Laqad qara'tuha ʿala al-jinni laylata al-jinni fakanoo ahsana mardoodan minkum kuntu kullama ataytu ʿala qawlihi : ( fb'a ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhibani ) qal-wa la bishay'in min niʿamika rabbana nukadhdhibu falaka al-hamdu

title: They prefer others over themselves
en: A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! I am suffering from fatigue and hunger." The Prophet (ﷺ) sent (somebody) to his wives (to get something), but the messenger found nothing with them. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said (to his companions). "Isn't there anybody who can entertain this man tonight so that Allah may be merciful to him?" An Ansari man got up and said, "I (will, entertain him), O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) !"
