So he went to his wife and said to her, "This is the guest of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , so do not keep anything away from him." She said. "By Allah, I have nothing but the children's food." He said, "When the children ask for their dinner, put them to bed and put out the light; we shall not take our meals tonight," She did so. In the morning the Ansari man went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  who said, "Allah was pleased with (or He bestowed His Mercy) on so-and-so and his wife (because of their good deed)." Then Allah revealed: 'But give them preference over themselves even though they were in need of that.' (59:9)
ar: حَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ غَزْوَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ الأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَتَى رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَصَابَنِي الْجَهْدُ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى نِسَائِهِ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ عِنْدَهُنَّ شَيْئًا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ رَجُلٌ يُضَيِّفُ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةَ يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَقَالَ لاِمْرَأَتِهِ ضَيْفُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ تَدَّخِرِيهِ شَيْئًا‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا عِنْدِي إِلاَّ قُوتُ الصِّبْيَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ الصِّبْيَةُ الْعَشَاءَ فَنَوِّمِيهِمْ، وَتَعَالَىْ فَأَطْفِئِي السِّرَاجَ وَنَطْوِي بُطُونَنَا اللَّيْلَةَ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَتْ ثُمَّ غَدَا الرَّجُلُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ عَجِبَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ـ أَوْ ضَحِكَ ـ مِنْ فُلاَنٍ وَفُلاَنَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ‏}‏
note: An Ansari family put out their lamp so their guest could eat.
tl: Haddathanee yaʿqoobu bnu ibraheema bni katheerin, haddathana aboo usamata, haddathana fudaylu bnu ghazwana, haddathana aboo hazimin al-ashjaʿiyyu, ʿan abee hurayrata radiya Allahu ʿanhu qala ata rajulun rasoola Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama faqala ya rasoola Allahi asabanee al-jahdu faarsala ila nisa'ihi falam yajid ʿindahunna shay'an, faqala rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama " ala rajulun yudayyifu hadhihi al-laylata yarhamuhu Allahu ". faqama rajulun mina al-ansari faqala ana ya rasoola Allahi. fadhahaba ila ahlihi faqala lamra'atihi dayfu rasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama la taddakhireehi shay'an. qal-t wallahi ma ʿindee ila qootu as-sibyati. qala faidha arada as-sibyatu al-ʿasha'a fanawwimeehim, wataʿal-a faatfi'ee as-siraja wanatwee butoonana al-laylata. fafaʿalat thumma ghada ar-rajulu ʿala rasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama faqala " laqad ʿajiba Allahu ʿazza wajalla aw dahika min fulanin wafulanata ". faanzala Allahu ʿazza wajalla “wayu'thiroona ʿala anfusihim walaw kana bihim khasasatun”

title: 'Others who have not yet joined them'
en: While we were sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) Surat Al-Jumu'a was revealed to him, and when the Verse, "And He (Allah) has sent him (Muhammad) also to other (Muslims).....' (62:3) was recited by the Prophet, I said, "Who are they, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" The Prophet (ﷺ) did not reply till I repeated my question thrice. At that time, Salman Al-Farisi was with us. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  put his hand on Salman, saying, "If Faith were at (the place of) Ath-Thuraiya (pleiades, the highest star), even then (some men or man from these people (i.e. Salman's folk) would attain it."
ar: ‏ لَوْ كَانَ الإِيمَانُ عِنْدَ الثُّرَيَّا لَنَالَهُ رِجَالٌ ـ أَوْ رَجُلٌ ـ مِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏
note: The Prophet ﷺ placed his hand on Salman al-Farisi.
tl: Law kana al-eemanu ʿinda ath-thurayya lanal-hu rijalun aw rajulun min ha'ula'i

title: Zayd ibn Arqam and the hypocrites
en: While I was taking part in a Ghazwa. I heard `Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Abi Salul) saying. "Don't spend on those who are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , that they may disperse and go away from him. If we return (to Medina), surely, the more honorable will expel the meaner amongst them." I reported that (saying) to my uncle or to `Umar who, in his turn, informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of it. The Prophet (ﷺ) called me and I narrated to him the whole story. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  sent for `Abdullah bin Ubai and his companions, and they took an oath that they did not say that. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  disbelieved my saying and believed his. I was distressed as I never was before. I stayed at home and my uncle said to me. "You just wanted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  to disbelieve your statement and hate you." So Allah revealed (the Sura beginning with) 'When the hypocrites come to you.' (63:1) The Prophet (ﷺ) then sent for me and recited it and said, "O Zaid! Allah confirmed your statement."
ar: ‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ صَدَّقَكَ يَا زَيْدُ ‏
note: A boy's truthful report was confirmed by revelation.
tl: Inna Allaha qad saddaqaka ya zaydu

title: Why do you forbid what Allah made lawful?
en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  used to drink honey in the house of Zainab, the daughter of Jahsh, and would stay there with her. So Hafsa and I agreed secretly that, if he come to either of us, she would say to him. "It seems you have eaten Maghafir (a kind of bad-smelling resin), for I smell in you the smell of Maghafir," (We did so) and he replied. "No, but I was drinking honey in the house of Zainab, the daughter of Jahsh, and I shall never take it again. I have taken an oath as to that, and you should not tell anybody about it."
ar: ‏ لاَ وَلَكِنِّي كُنْتُ أَشْرَبُ عَسَلاً عِنْدَ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ فَلَنْ أَعُودَ لَهُ وَقَدْ حَلَفْتُ لاَ تُخْبِرِي بِذَلِكِ أَحَدًا ‏
note: The background of Surah At-Tahrim.
tl: La walakinnee kuntu ashrabu ʿasalan ʿinda zaynaba ibnati jahshin falan aʿooda lahu waqad halaftu la tukhbiree bidhaliki ahadan

title: The surah that intercedes
en: that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Indeed there is a Surah in the Qur'an of thirty Ayat, which intercedes for a man until he is forgiven. It is [Surah] Tabarak Alladhi Biyadihil-Mulk."
ar: ‏ إِنَّ سُورَةً مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ثَلاَثُونَ آيَةً شَفَعَتْ لِرَجُلٍ حَتَّى غُفِرَ لَهُ وَهِيَ سُورَةُ تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ ‏
note: Surah Al-Mulk, thirty verses, intercedes for its reciter until he is forgiven.
tl: Inna sooratan mina al-qur'ani thalathoona ayatan shafaʿat lirajulin hatta ghufira lahu wahiya sooratu tabaraka alladhee biyadihi al-mulku

title: Al-Mulk intercedes for its reader
en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: A surah of the Qur'an containing thirty verses will intercede its reader till he will be forgiven. That is: "Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the sovereignty" (Surah 67).
ar: ‏ سُورَةٌ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ثَلاَثُونَ آيَةً تَشْفَعُ لِصَاحِبِهَا حَتَّى يُغْفَرَ لَهُ ‏{‏ تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ ‏}‏ ‏
note: Another narration of the virtue of Surah Al-Mulk.
tl: Sooratun mina al-qur'ani thalathoona ayatan tashfaʿu lisahibiha hatta yughfara lahu “ tabaraka alladhee biyadihi al-mulku ”

title: The idols of the people of Nuh
en: All the idols which were worshiped by the people of Noah were worshiped by the Arabs later on. As for the idol Wadd, it was worshiped by the tribe of Kalb at Daumat-al-Jandal; Suwa` was the idol of (the tribe of) Hudhail; Yaghouth was worshiped by (the tribe of) Murad and then by Bani Ghutaif at Al-Jurf near Saba; Ya`uq was the idol of Hamdan, and Nasr was the idol of Himyar, the branch of Dhi-al-Kala`. The names (of the idols) formerly belonged to some pious men of the people of Noah, and when they died Satan inspired their people to (prepare and place idols at the places where they used to sit, and to call those idols by their names. The people did so, but the idols were not worshiped till those people (who initiated them) had died and the origin of the idols had become obscure, whereupon people began worshiping them.
ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، وَقَالَ، عَطَاءٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ صَارَتِ الأَوْثَانُ الَّتِي كَانَتْ فِي قَوْمِ نُوحٍ فِي الْعَرَبِ بَعْدُ، أَمَّا وُدٌّ كَانَتْ لِكَلْبٍ بِدَوْمَةِ الْجَنْدَلِ، وَأَمَّا سُوَاعٌ كَانَتْ لِهُذَيْلٍ، وَأَمَّا يَغُوثُ فَكَانَتْ لِمُرَادٍ ثُمَّ لِبَنِي غُطَيْفٍ بِالْجُرُفِ عِنْدَ سَبَا، وَأَمَّا يَعُوقُ فَكَانَتْ لِهَمْدَانَ، وَأَمَّا نَسْرٌ فَكَانَتْ لِحِمْيَرَ، لآلِ ذِي الْكَلاَعِ‏.‏ أَسْمَاءُ رِجَالٍ صَالِحِينَ مِنْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ، فَلَمَّا هَلَكُوا أَوْحَى الشَّيْطَانُ إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ أَنِ انْصِبُوا إِلَى مَجَالِسِهِمُ الَّتِي كَانُوا يَجْلِسُونَ أَنْصَابًا، وَسَمُّوهَا بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ فَفَعَلُوا فَلَمْ تُعْبَدْ حَتَّى إِذَا هَلَكَ أُولَئِكَ وَتَنَسَّخَ الْعِلْمُ عُبِدَتْ‏.‏
note: How the names of righteous men became idols, later worshipped in Arabia.
tl: Haddathana ibraheemu bnu moosa, akhbarana hishamun, ʿani ibni jurayjin, waqala, ʿata'un ʿani ibni ʿabbasin radiya Allahu ʿanhuma sarati al-awthanu allatee kanat fee qawmi noohin fee al-ʿarabi baʿdu, amma wuddun kanat likalbin bidawmati al-jandali, waamma suwaʿun kanat lihudhaylin, waamma yaghoothu fakanat limuradin thumma libanee ghutayfin bil-jurufi ʿinda saba, waamma yaʿooqu fakanat lihamdana, waamma nasrun fakanat lihimyara, l'ali dhee al-kalaʿi. asma'u rijalin sal-heena min qawmi noohin, falamma halakoo awha ash-shaytanu ila qawmihim ani insiboo ila majal-sihimu allatee kanoo yajlisoona ansaban, wasammooha biasma'ihim fafaʿaloo falam tuʿbad hatta idha halaka oola'ika watanassakha al-ʿilmu ʿubidat.

title: The jinn who listened to the Quran
en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  went out along with a group of his companions towards `Ukaz Market. At that time something intervened between the devils and the news of the Heaven, and flames were sent down upon them, so the devils returned. Their fellow-devils said, "What is wrong with you? " They said, "Something has intervened between us and the news of the Heaven, and fires (flames) have been shot at us." Their fellow-devils said, "Nothing has intervened between you and the news of the Heaven, but an important event has happened. Therefore, travel all over the world, east and west, and try to find out what has happened." And so they set out and travelled all over the world, east and west, looking for that thing which intervened between them and the news of the Heaven. Those of the devils who had set out towards Tihama, went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  at Nakhla (a place between Mecca and Taif) while he was on his way to `Ukaz Market. (They met him) while he was offering the Fajr prayer with his companions. When they heard the Holy Qur'an being recited (by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ), they listened to it and said (to each other). This is the thing which has intervened between you and the news of the Heavens." Then they returned to their people and said, "O our people! We have really heard a wonderful recital (Qur'an). It gives guidance to the right, and we have believed therein. We shall not join in worship, anybody with our Lord." (See 72:1-2) Then Allah revealed to His Prophet (Surat al- Jinn): 'Say: It has been revealed to me that a group (3 to 9) of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an).' (72:1) The statement of the Jinns was revealed to him .
ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ انْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَائِفَةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ عَامِدِينَ إِلَى سُوقِ عُكَاظٍ، وَقَدْ حِيلَ بَيْنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ، وَأُرْسِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّهُبُ فَرَجَعَتِ الشَّيَاطِينُ فَقَالُوا مَا لَكُمْ فَقَالُوا حِيلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ وَأُرْسِلَتْ عَلَيْنَا الشُّهُبُ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا حَالَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ إِلاَّ مَا حَدَثَ، فَاضْرِبُوا مَشَارِقَ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا فَانْظُرُوا مَا هَذَا الأَمْرُ الَّذِي حَدَثَ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقُوا فَضَرَبُوا مَشَارِقَ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا يَنْظُرُونَ مَا هَذَا الأَمْرُ الَّذِي حَالَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقَ الَّذِينَ تَوَجَّهُوا نَحْوَ تِهَامَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَخْلَةَ، وَهْوَ عَامِدٌ إِلَى سُوقِ عُكَاظٍ، وَهْوَ يُصَلِّي بِأَصْحَابِهِ صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ، فَلَمَّا سَمِعُوا الْقُرْآنَ تَسَمَّعُوا لَهُ فَقَالُوا هَذَا الَّذِي حَالَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ‏.‏ فَهُنَالِكَ رَجَعُوا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَقَالُوا يَا قَوْمَنَا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ، وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا‏.‏ وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَى نَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ‏}‏ وَإِنَّمَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْهِ قَوْلُ الْجِنِّ‏.‏
note: The jinn heard the Prophet ﷺ leading Fajr, and believed.
tl: Haddathana moosa bnu ismaʿeela, haddathana aboo ʿawanata, ʿan abee bishrin, ʿan saʿeedi bni jubayrin, ʿani ibni ʿabbasin, qala intalaqa rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama fee ta'ifatin min ashabihi ʿamideena ila sooqi ʿukazin, waqad heela bayna ash-shayateeni wabayna khabari as-sama'i, waursilat ʿalayhimu ash-shuhubu farajaʿati ash-shayateenu faqal-wa ma lakum faqal-wa heela baynana wabayna khabari as-sama'i waursilat ʿalayna ash-shuhubu. qala ma hala baynakum wabayna khabari as-sama'i ila ma hadatha, fadriboo mashariqa al-ardi wamagharibaha fanzuroo ma hadha al-amru alladhee hadatha. fantalaqoo fadaraboo mashariqa al-ardi wamagharibaha yanzuroona ma hadha al-amru alladhee hala baynahum wabayna khabari as-sama'i. qala fantalaqa alladheena tawajjahoo nahwa tihamata ila rasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama binakhlata, wahwa ʿamidun ila sooqi ʿukazin, wahwa yusallee biashabihi salata al-fajri, falamma samiʿoo al-qur'ana tasammaʿoo lahu faqal-wa hadha alladhee hala baynakum wabayna khabari as-sama'i. fahunal-ka rajaʿoo ila qawmihim faqal-wa ya qawmana inna samiʿna qur'anan ʿajaban yahdee ila ar-rushdi faamanna bihi, walan nushrika birabbina ahadan. waanzala Allahu ʿazza wajalla ʿala nabiyyihi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama “qul oohiya ila annahu istamaʿa nafarun mina al-jinni” wainnama oohiya ilayhi qawlu al-jinni.

title: 'O you wrapped in your cloak'
en: I asked Aba Salama bin `Abdur-Rahman about the first Sura revealed of the Qur'an. He replied "O you, wrapped-up (i.e. Al Muddaththir)." I said, "They say it was, 'Read, in the Name of your Lord Who created,' (i.e. Surat Al-`Alaq (the Clot)." On that, Abu Salama said, "I asked Jabir bin `Abdullah about that, saying the same as you have said, whereupon he said, 'I will not tell you except what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  had told us. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said, "I was in seclusion in the cave of Hiram', and after I completed the limited period of my seclusion. I came down (from the cave) and heard a voice calling me. I looked to my right, but saw nothing. Then I looked up and saw something. So I went to Khadija (the Prophet's wife) and told her to wrap me up and pour cold water on me. So they wrapped me up and poured cold water on me." Then, 'O you, (Muhammad) wrapped up! Arise and warn,' (Surat Al Muddaththir) was revealed." (74:1)
ar: ‏ جَاوَرْتُ بِحِرَاءٍ، فَلَمَّا قَضَيْتُ جِوَارِي هَبَطْتُ فَنُودِيتُ فَنَظَرْتُ عَنْ يَمِينِي فَلَمْ أَرَ شَيْئًا، وَنَظَرْتُ عَنْ شِمَالِي فَلَمْ أَرَ شَيْئًا، وَنَظَرْتُ أَمَامِي فَلَمْ أَرَ شَيْئًا، وَنَظَرْتُ خَلْفِي فَلَمْ أَرَ شَيْئًا، فَرَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي فَرَأَيْتُ شَيْئًا، فَأَتَيْتُ خَدِيجَةَ فَقُلْتُ دَثِّرُونِي وَصُبُّوا عَلَىَّ مَاءً بَارِدًا ـ قَالَ ـ فَدَثَّرُونِي وَصَبُّوا عَلَىَّ مَاءً بَارِدًا قَالَ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ * قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ * وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ‏}‏ ‏
note: The revelation resumes after the first pause.
tl: Jawartu bihira'in, falamma qadaytu jiwaree habattu fanoodeetu fanazartu ʿan yameenee falam ara shay'an, wanazartu ʿan shimal-y falam ara shay'an, wanazartu amamee falam ara shay'an, wanazartu khalfee falam ara shay'an, farafaʿtu ra'see fara'aytu shay'an, faataytu khadeejata faqultu daththiroonee wasubboo ʿala ma'an baridan qala fadaththaroonee wasabboo ʿala ma'an baridan qala fanazalat “ya ayyuha al-muddaththiru * qum faandhir * warabbaka fakabbir”

title: Do not hasten with your tongue
en: Ibn 'Abbas in the explanation of the statement of Allah "Move not your tongue concerning (the Quran) to make haste therewith." (75:16) said "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  used to bear the revelation with great trouble and used to move his lips (quickly) with the Inspiration." Ibn 'Abbas moved his lips saying, "I am moving my lips in front of you as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  used to move his." Said moved his lips saying: "I am moving my lips, as I saw Ibn 'Abbas moving his." Ibn 'Abbas added, "So Allah revealed 'Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur'an) to make haste therewith. It is for Us to collect it and to give you (O Muhammad) the ability to recite it (the Quran)' (75:16-17) which means that Allah will make him (the Prophet) remember the portion of the Qur'an which was revealed at that time by heart and recite it. The statement of Allah: 'And when we have recited it to you (O Muhammad through Gabriel) then you follow its (Quran) recital' (75:18) means 'listen to it and be silent.' Then it is for Us (Allah) to make it clear to you' (75:19) means 'Then it is (for Allah) to make you recite it (and its meaning will be clear by itself through your tongue). Afterwards, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  used to listen to Gabriel whenever he came and after his departure he used to recite it as Gabriel had recited it."
ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ‏}‏ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَالِجُ مِنَ التَّنْزِيلِ شِدَّةً، وَكَانَ مِمَّا يُحَرِّكُ شَفَتَيْهِ ـ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَأَنَا أُحَرِّكُهُمَا لَكُمْ كَمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَرِّكُهُمَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ أَنَا أُحَرِّكُهُمَا كَمَا رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يُحَرِّكُهُمَا‏.‏ فَحَرَّكَ شَفَتَيْهِ ـ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ* إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ‏}‏ قَالَ جَمْعُهُ لَهُ فِي صَدْرِكَ، وَتَقْرَأَهُ ‏{‏فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ‏}‏ قَالَ فَاسْتَمِعْ لَهُ وَأَنْصِتْ ‏{‏ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ‏}‏ ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا أَنْ تَقْرَأَهُ‏.‏ فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ اسْتَمَعَ، فَإِذَا انْطَلَقَ جِبْرِيلُ قَرَأَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا قَرَأَهُ‏.‏
note: How the Prophet ﷺ received and memorised revelation.
tl: Haddathana moosa bnu ismaʿeela, qala haddathana aboo ʿawanata, qala haddathana moosa bnu abee ʿa'ishata, qala haddathana saʿeedu bnu jubayrin, ʿani ibni ʿabbasin, fee qawlihi taʿal-a “la tuharrik bihi lisanaka litaʿjala bihi” qala kana rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama yuʿal-ju mina at-tanzeeli shiddatan, wakana mimma yuharriku shafatayhi faqala ibnu ʿabbasin faana uharrikuhuma lakum kama kana rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama yuharrikuhuma. waqala saʿeedun ana uharrikuhuma kama ra'aytu ibna ʿabbasin yuharrikuhuma. faharraka shafatayhi faanzala Allahu taʿal-a “la tuharrik bihi lisanaka litaʿjala bihi* inna ʿalayna jamʿahu waqur'anahu” qala jamʿuhu lahu fee sadrika, wataqra'ahu “faidha qara'nahu fattabiʿ qur'anahu” qala fastamiʿ lahu waansit “thumma inna ʿalayna bayanahu” thumma inna ʿalayna an taqra'ahu. fakana rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama baʿda dhalika idha atahu jibreelu istamaʿa, faidha intalaqa jibreelu qara'ahu an-nabiyyu salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama kama qara'ahu.

title: Al-Mursalat revealed in a cave at Mina
en: We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when Surat Wal-Mursalat was revealed to him. While we were receiving it from his mouth, a snake suddenly came and we ran to kill it, but it outstripped us and entered its hole quickly. Allah's le said, "It has escaped your evil, and you too, have escaped its evil."
ar: ‏ وُقِيَتْ شَرَّكُمْ، كَمَا وُقِيتُمْ شَرَّهَا ‏
note: The Companions received the surah fresh from his mouth.
tl: Wuqiyat sharrakum, kama wuqeetum sharraha

title: 'I and the Hour are like these two'
en: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  pointing with his index and middle fingers, saying. "The time of my Advent and the Hour are like these two fingers."
ar: ‏ بُعِثْتُ وَالسَّاعَةَ كَهَاتَيْنِ ‏
note: The nearness of the Hour.
tl: Buʿithtu was-saʿata kahatayni

title: 'He frowned and turned away'
en: “He frowned and turned away” was revealed about Ibn Umm Maktum the blind man. He came to the Messenger of Allah saying: ‘O Messenger of Allah! Guide me.’ At that time, there was a revered man from the idolaters with the Messenger of Allah. So the Messenger of Allah turned away from him and faced the other man, saying: ‘Do you think that there is something wrong with what I am saying?’ He said: ‘No.’ So it was about that that it was revealed.”
ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، هَذَا مَا عَرَضْنَا عَلَى هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أُنْزِلَ ‏:‏ ‏(‏ عبَسَ وَتَوَلَّى ‏)‏ فِي ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ الأَعْمَى أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرْشِدْنِي وَعِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ مِنْ عُظَمَاءِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعْرِضُ عَنْهُ وَيُقْبِلُ عَلَى الآخَرِ وَيَقُولُ أَتَرَى بِمَا أَقُولُ بَأْسًا فَيُقَالُ لاَ ‏.‏ فَفِي هَذَا أُنْزِلَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ ‏.‏ وَرَوَى بَعْضُهُمْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ أُنْزِلََ ‏:‏ ‏(‏ عبَسَ وَتَوَلَّى ‏)‏ فِي ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ‏.‏
note: Revealed about the blind Companion Ibn Umm Maktum.
tl: Haddathana saʿeedu bnu yahya bni saʿeedin al-umawiyyu, haddathanee abee qala, hadha ma ʿaradna ʿala hishami bni ʿurwata ʿan abeehi, ʿan ʿa'ishata, qal-t unzila : ( ʿbasa watawalla ) fee ibni ummi maktoomin al-aʿma ata rasoola Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama fajaʿala yaqoolu ya rasoola Allahi arshidnee waʿinda rasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama rajulun min ʿuzama'i al-mushrikeena fajaʿala rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama yuʿridu ʿanhu wayuqbilu ʿala al-akhari wayaqoolu atara bima aqoolu ba'san fayuqalu la. fafee hadha unzila. qala aboo ʿeesa hadha hadeethun hasanun ghareebun. warawa baʿduhum hadha al-hadeetha ʿan hishami bni ʿurwata ʿan abeehi qala unzila : ( ʿbasa watawalla ) fee ibni ummi maktoomin. walam yadhkur feehi ʿan ʿa'ishata.

title: To see the Day of Resurrection
en: The Messenger of Allah said: “Whoever wishes to look at the Day of Resurrection, as if he is seeing it with this eye, then let him recite: ‘When the sun Kuwwirat’ and ‘When the heaven is cleft sunder (Infatarat) and ‘When the heaven is split asunder.’”
ar: ‏ مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ كَأَنَّهُ رَأْىُ عَيْنٍ فَلْيَقْرَأْ ‏(‏ إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ ‏)‏ و ‏(‏إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْفَطَرَتْ ‏)‏ وَ ‏(‏إذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ ‏)‏ ‏
note: These three surahs depict the Last Day so vividly it is as if one sees it.
tl: Man sarrahu an yanzura ila yawmi al-qiyamati ka'annahu ra'a ʿaynin falyaqra' ( idha ash-shamsu kuwwirat ) w (idha as-sama'u infatarat ) wa (dha as-sama'u inshaqqat )

title: The stain upon the heart
en: the Messenger of Allah said: “Verily, when the slave (of Allah) commits a sin, a black spot appears on his heart. When he refrains from it, seeks forgiveness and repents, his heart is polished clean. But if he returns, it increases until it covers his entire heart. And that is the ‘Ran’ which Allah mentioned: ‘Nay, but on their hearts is the Ran which they used to earn.’”
ar: ‏ إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا أَخْطَأَ خَطِيئَةً نُكِتَتْ فِي قَلْبِهِ نُكْتَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ فَإِذَا هُوَ نَزَعَ وَاسْتَغْفَرَ وَتَابَ سُقِلَ قَلْبُهُ وَإِنْ عَادَ زِيدَ فِيهَا حَتَّى تَعْلُوَ قَلْبَهُ وَهُوَ الرَّانُ الَّذِي ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ ‏:‏ ‏(‏ كلاَّ بَلْ رَانَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ ‏)‏ ‏
note: Sins stain the heart, and repentance polishes it. Compare the 'sound heart' of 26:89.
tl: Inna al-ʿabda idha akhta'a khatee'atan nukitat fee qalbihi nuktatun sawda'u faidha huwa nazaʿa wastaghfara wataba suqila qalbuhu wain ʿada zeeda feeha hatta taʿluwa qalbahu wahuwa ar-ranu alladhee dhakara Allahu : ( kla bal rana ʿala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona )

title: Prostration in Al-Inshiqaq
en: I offered the `Isha' prayer behind Abu Huraira and he recited, "Idha s-samaa'u n-shaqqat" (84) and prostrated. On my inquiring, he said, "I prostrated behind Abul-Qasim (the Prophet) (when he recited that Sura) and I will go on doing it till I meet him."
ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ الْعَتَمَةَ فَقَرَأَ ‏{‏إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ‏}‏ فَسَجَدَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ قَالَ سَجَدْتُ خَلْفَ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ أَزَالُ أَسْجُدُ بِهَا حَتَّى أَلْقَاهُ‏.‏
note: Abu Hurayrah prostrated as he had seen the Prophet ﷺ do.
tl: Haddathana aboo an-nuʿmani, qala haddathana muʿtamirun, ʿan abeehi, ʿan bakrin, ʿan abee rafiʿin, qala sallaytu maʿa abee hurayrata al-ʿatamata faqara'a “idha as-sama'u inshaqqat” fasajada faqultu lahu qala sajadtu khalfa abee al-qasimi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama fala azalu asjudu biha hatta alqahu.

title: Al-A'la and Al-Ghashiyah on Fridays and 'Eid
narrator: Nu'man b. Bashir reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite on two 'Ids and in Friday prayer:
en: " Glorify The name of Your Lord, the Most High" (Surah lxxxvii.), and:" Has there come to you the news of the overwhelming event" (lxxxviii.). And when the 'Id and Jumu'a combined on a day he recited these two (surah) in both the prayers.
ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَإِسْحَاقُ جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ، سَالِمٍ مَوْلَى النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ وَفِي الْجُمُعَةِ بِـ ‏{‏ سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الأَعْلَى‏}‏ وَ ‏{‏ هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ‏}‏ قَالَ وَإِذَا اجْتَمَعَ الْعِيدُ وَالْجُمُعَةُ فِي يَوْمٍ وَاحِدٍ يَقْرَأُ بِهِمَا أَيْضًا فِي الصَّلاَتَيْنِ.
note: The Prophet ﷺ recited these two in the Friday and 'Eid prayers.
tl: Haddathana yahya bnu yahya, waaboo bakri bnu abee shaybata waishaqu jameeʿan ʿan jareerin, - qala yahya akhbarana jareerun, - ʿan ibraheema bni muhammadi bni al-muntashiri, ʿan abeehi, ʿan habeebi bni, sal-min mawla an-nuʿmani bni basheerin ʿani an-nuʿmani bni basheerin, qala kana rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama yaqra'u fee al-ʿeedayni wafee al-jumuʿati bi “ sabbihi isma rabbika al-aʿla” wa “ hal ataka hadeethu al-ghashiyati” qala waidha ijtamaʿa al-ʿeedu wal-jumuʿatu fee yawmin wahidin yaqra'u bihima aydan fee as-salatayni.

title: Make the prayer light for people
en: Once a man was driving two Nadihas (camels used for agricultural purposes) and night had fallen. He found Mu`adh praying so he made his camel kneel and joined Mu`adh in the prayer. The latter recited Surat 'Al-Baqara" or Surat "An-Nisa", (so) the man left the prayer and went away. When he came to know that Mu`adh had criticized him, he went to the Prophet, and complained against Mu`adh. The Prophet (ﷺ) said thrice, "O Mu`adh ! Are you putting the people to trial?" It would have been better if you had recited "Sabbih Isma Rabbika-l-A`la (87)", Wash-shamsi wa duhaha (91)", or "Wal-laili idha yaghsha (92)", for the old, the weak and the needy pray behind you." Jabir said that Mu`adh recited Sura Al-Baqara in the `Isha' prayer.
ar: ‏ يَا مُعَاذُ أَفَتَّانٌ أَنْتَ ـ أَوْ فَاتِنٌ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ ـ فَلَوْلاَ صَلَّيْتَ بِسَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ، وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا، وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى، فَإِنَّهُ يُصَلِّي وَرَاءَكَ الْكَبِيرُ وَالضَّعِيفُ وَذُو الْحَاجَةِ ‏
note: The Prophet ﷺ recommended these short surahs to an imam whose prayer was too long.
tl: Ya muʿadhu afattanun anta aw fatinun thalatha mirarin falawla sallayta bisabbihi isma rabbika, wash-shamsi waduhaha, wal-layli idha yaghsha, fainnahu yusallee wara'aka al-kabeeru wad-daʿeefu wadhoo al-hajati

title: Your Lord has not forsaken you
en: Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  became sick and could not offer his night prayer (Tahajjud) for two or three nights. Then a lady (the wife of Abu Lahab) came and said, "O Muhammad! I think that your Satan has forsaken you, for I have not seen him with you for two or three nights!" On that Allah revealed: 'By the fore-noon, and by the night when it darkens, your Lord (O Muhammad) has neither forsaken you, nor hated you.' (93:1-3)
ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جُنْدُبَ بْنَ سُفْيَانَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ اشْتَكَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَقُمْ لَيْلَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، فَجَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَتْ يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنِّي لأَرْجُو أَنْ يَكُونَ شَيْطَانُكَ قَدْ تَرَكَكَ، لَمْ أَرَهُ قَرِبَكَ مُنْذُ لَيْلَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏وَالضُّحَى * وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَى * مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَى‏}‏
note: Revealed after a pause, when a woman mocked the Prophet ﷺ.
tl: Haddathana ahmadu bnu yoonusa, haddathana zuhayrun, haddathana al-aswadu bnu qaysin, qala samiʿtu junduba bna sufyana radiya Allahu ʿanhu qala ishtaka rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama falam yaqum laylatayni aw thalathan, faja'ati imra'atun faqal-t ya muhammadu innee l'arjoo an yakoona shaytanuka qad tarakaka, lam arahu qaribaka mundhu laylatayni aw thalathan. faanzala Allahu ʿazza wajalla “wad-duha * wal-layli idha saja * ma waddaʿaka rabbuka wama qala”

title: At-Tin in the night prayer
en: The Prophet (ﷺ) was on a journey and recited in one of the first two rak`at of the `Isha' prayer "Wa t-teeni wa z-zaitun." (95)
ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَقَرَأَ فِي الْعِشَاءِ فِي إِحْدَى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بِالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ‏.‏
note: Recited by the Prophet ﷺ on a journey.
tl: Haddathana aboo al-waleedi, qala haddathana shuʿbatu, ʿan ʿadiyyin, qala samiʿtu al-bara'a, anna an-nabiyya salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama kana fee safarin faqara'a fee al-ʿisha'i fee ihda ar-rakʿatayni bit-teeni waz-zaytooni.

title: The first revelation: 'Read!'
narrator: Narrated 'Aisha (the mother of the faithful believers):
en: The commencement of the Divine Inspiration to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  was in the form of good dreams which came true like bright daylight, and then the love of seclusion was bestowed upon him. He used to go in seclusion in the cave of Hira where he used to worship (Allah alone) continuously for many days before his desire to see his family. He used to take with him the journey food for the stay and then come back to (his wife) Khadija to take his food likewise again till suddenly the Truth descended upon him while he was in the cave of Hira. The angel came to him and asked him to read. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "I do not know how to read." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "The angel caught me (forcefully) and pressed me so hard that I could not bear it any more. He then released me and again asked me to read and I replied, 'I do not know how to read.' Thereupon he caught me again and pressed me a second time till I could not bear it any more. He then released me and again asked me to read but again I replied, 'I do not know how to read (or what shall I read)?' Thereupon he caught me for the third time and pressed me, and then released me and said, 'Read in the name of your Lord, who has created (all that exists), created man from a clot. Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous." (96:1, 96:2, 96:3) Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  returned with the Inspiration and with his heart beating severely. Then he went to Khadija bint Khuwailid and said, "Cover me! Cover me!" They covered him till his fear was over and after that he told her everything that had happened and said, "I fear that something may happen to me." Khadija replied, "Never! By Allah, Allah will never disgrace you. You keep good relations with your kith and kin, help the poor and the destitute, serve your guests generously and assist the deserving calamity-afflicted ones." Khadija then accompanied him to her cousin Waraqa bin Naufal bin Asad bin 'Abdul 'Uzza, who, during the pre-Islamic Period became a Christian and used to write the writing with Hebrew letters. He would write from the Gospel in Hebrew as much as Allah wished him to write. He was an old man and had lost his eyesight. Khadija said to Waraqa, "Listen to the story of your nephew, O my cousin!" Waraqa asked, "O my nephew! What have you seen?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  described whatever he had seen. Waraqa said, "This is the same one who keeps the secrets (angel Gabriel) whom Allah had sent to Moses. I wish I were young and could live up to the time when your people would turn you out." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  asked, "Will they drive me out?" Waraqa replied in the affirmative and said, "Anyone (man) who came with something similar to what you have brought was treated with hostility; and if I should remain alive till the day when you will be turned out then I would support you strongly." But after a few days Waraqa died and the Divine Inspiration was also paused for a while.
ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ أَوَّلُ مَا بُدِئَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْوَحْىِ الرُّؤْيَا الصَّالِحَةُ فِي النَّوْمِ، فَكَانَ لاَ يَرَى رُؤْيَا إِلاَّ جَاءَتْ مِثْلَ فَلَقِ الصُّبْحِ، ثُمَّ حُبِّبَ إِلَيْهِ الْخَلاَءُ، وَكَانَ يَخْلُو بِغَارِ حِرَاءٍ فَيَتَحَنَّثُ فِيهِ ـ وَهُوَ التَّعَبُّدُ ـ اللَّيَالِيَ ذَوَاتِ الْعَدَدِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْزِعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ، وَيَتَزَوَّدُ لِذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى خَدِيجَةَ، فَيَتَزَوَّدُ لِمِثْلِهَا، حَتَّى جَاءَهُ الْحَقُّ وَهُوَ فِي غَارِ حِرَاءٍ، فَجَاءَهُ الْمَلَكُ فَقَالَ اقْرَأْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَنَا بِقَارِئٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَخَذَنِي فَغَطَّنِي حَتَّى بَلَغَ مِنِّي الْجَهْدَ، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي فَقَالَ اقْرَأْ‏.‏ قُلْتُ مَا أَنَا بِقَارِئٍ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَنِي فَغَطَّنِي الثَّانِيَةَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ مِنِّي الْجَهْدَ، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي فَقَالَ اقْرَأْ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مَا أَنَا بِقَارِئٍ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَنِي فَغَطَّنِي الثَّالِثَةَ، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي فَقَالَ ‏{‏اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ * خَلَقَ الإِنْسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ * اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الأَكْرَمُ‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْجُفُ فُؤَادُهُ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَى خَدِيجَةَ بِنْتِ خُوَيْلِدٍ رضى الله عنها فَقَالَ ‏"‏ زَمِّلُونِي زَمِّلُونِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَزَمَّلُوهُ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ الرَّوْعُ، فَقَالَ لِخَدِيجَةَ وَأَخْبَرَهَا الْخَبَرَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ خَدِيجَةُ كَلاَّ وَاللَّهِ مَا يُخْزِيكَ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا، إِنَّكَ لَتَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ، وَتَحْمِلُ الْكَلَّ، وَتَكْسِبُ الْمَعْدُومَ، وَتَقْرِي الضَّيْفَ، وَتُعِينُ عَلَى نَوَائِبِ الْحَقِّ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَتْ بِهِ خَدِيجَةُ حَتَّى أَتَتْ بِهِ وَرَقَةَ بْنَ نَوْفَلِ بْنِ أَسَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعُزَّى ابْنَ عَمِّ خَدِيجَةَ ـ وَكَانَ امْرَأً تَنَصَّرَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَكَانَ يَكْتُبُ الْكِتَابَ الْعِبْرَانِيَّ، فَيَكْتُبُ مِنَ الإِنْجِيلِ بِالْعِبْرَانِيَّةِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ، وَكَانَ شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا قَدْ عَمِيَ ـ فَقَالَتْ لَهُ خَدِيجَةُ يَا ابْنَ عَمِّ اسْمَعْ مِنَ ابْنِ أَخِيكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ وَرَقَةُ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي مَاذَا تَرَى فَأَخْبَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَبَرَ مَا رَأَى‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ وَرَقَةُ هَذَا النَّامُوسُ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى مُوسَى صلى الله عليه وسلم يَا لَيْتَنِي فِيهَا جَذَعًا، لَيْتَنِي أَكُونُ حَيًّا إِذْ يُخْرِجُكَ قَوْمُكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوَمُخْرِجِيَّ هُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ، لَمْ يَأْتِ رَجُلٌ قَطُّ بِمِثْلِ مَا جِئْتَ بِهِ إِلاَّ عُودِيَ، وَإِنْ يُدْرِكْنِي يَوْمُكَ أَنْصُرْكَ نَصْرًا مُؤَزَّرًا‏.‏ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْشَبْ وَرَقَةُ أَنْ تُوُفِّيَ وَفَتَرَ الْوَحْىُ‏.‏
note: The beginning of revelation in the cave of Hira.
tl: Haddathana yahya bnu bukayrin, qala haddathana al-laythu, ʿan ʿuqaylin, ʿani ibni shihabin, ʿan ʿurwata bni az-zubayri, ʿan ʿa'ishata ummi al-mu'mineena, annaha qal-t awwalu ma budi'a bihi rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama mina al-waha ar-ru'ya as-sal-hatu fee an-nawmi, fakana la yara ru'ya ila ja'at mithla falaqi as-subhi, thumma hubbiba ilayhi al-khala'u, wakana yakhloo bighari hira'in fayatahannathu feehi wahuwa at-taʿabbudu al-layal-ya dhawati al-ʿadadi qabla an yanziʿa ila ahlihi, wayatazawwadu lidhalika, thumma yarjiʿu ila khadeejata, fayatazawwadu limithliha, hatta ja'ahu al-haqqu wahuwa fee ghari hira'in, faja'ahu al-malaku faqala iqra'. qala " ma ana biqari'in ". qala " faakhadhanee faghattanee hatta balagha minnee al-jahda, thumma arsalanee faqala iqra'. qultu ma ana biqari'in. faakhadhanee faghattanee ath-thaniyata hatta balagha minnee al-jahda, thumma arsalanee faqala iqra'. faqultu ma ana biqari'in. faakhadhanee faghattanee ath-thal-thata, thumma arsalanee faqala “iqra' bismi rabbika alladhee khalaqa * khalaqa al-insana min ʿalaqin * iqra' warabbuka al-akramu” ". farajaʿa biha rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama yarjufu fu'aduhu, fadakhala ʿala khadeejata binti khuwaylidin radiya Allahu ʿanhu faqala " zammiloonee zammiloonee ". fazammaloohu hatta dhahaba ʿanhu ar-rawʿu, faqala likhadeejata waakhbaraha al-khabara " laqad khasheetu ʿala nafsee ". faqal-t khadeejatu kala wallahi ma yukhzeeka Allahu abadan, innaka latasilu ar-rahima, watahmilu al-kalla, wataksibu al-maʿdooma, wataqree ad-dayfa, watuʿeenu ʿala nawa'ibi al-haqqi. fantalaqat bihi khadeejatu hatta atat bihi waraqata bna nawfali bni asadi bni ʿabdi al-ʿuzza ibna ʿammi khadeejata wakana imra'an tanassara fee al-jahiliyyati, wakana yaktubu al-kitaba al-ʿibraniyya, fayaktubu mina al-injeeli bil-ʿibraniyyati ma sha'a Allahu an yaktuba, wakana shaykhan kabeeran qad ʿamiya faqal-t lahu khadeejatu ya ibna ʿammi ismaʿ mina ibni akheeka. faqala lahu waraqatu ya ibna akhee madha tara faakhbarahu rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama khabara ma ra'a. faqala lahu waraqatu hadha an-namoosu alladhee nazzala Allahu ʿala moosa salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama ya laytanee feeha jadhaʿan, laytanee akoonu hayyan idh yukhrijuka qawmuka. faqala rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama " awamukhrijiyya hum ". qala naʿam, lam ya'ti rajulun qattu bimithli ma ji'ta bihi ila ʿoodiya, wain yudriknee yawmuka ansurka nasran mu'azzaran. thumma lam yanshab waraqatu an tuwuffiya wafatara al-waha.

title: Seek Laylat al-Qadr
en: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said, "Search for the Night of Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan."
ar: ‏ تَحَرَّوْا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فِي الْوِتْرِ مِنَ الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ ‏
note: In the odd nights of the last ten of Ramadan.
tl: Taharrawa laylata al-qadri fee al-witri mina al-ʿashri al-awakhiri min ramadana

title: 'Did Allah mention me by name?'
en: The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ubai (bin Ka`b). "Allah has ordered me to recite to you:--'Those who disbelieve among the people of the Scripture and among the idolators are not going to stop (from their disbelief.') (Sura 98) Ubai said, "Did Allah mention me by name?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." On that, Ubai wept.
ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأُبَىٍّ‏.‏ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَقْرَأَ عَلَيْكَ ‏{‏لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَمَّانِي قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَبَكَى‏.‏
note: Allah commanded the Prophet ﷺ to recite Al-Bayyinah to Ubayy ibn Ka'b.
tl: Haddathana muhammadu bnu bashsharin, haddathana ghundarun, haddathana shuʿbatu, samiʿtu qatadata, ʿan anasi bni mal-kin radiya Allahu ʿanhu qala an-nabiyyu salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama l'uba. " inna Allaha amaranee an aqra'a ʿalayka “lam yakuni alladheena kafaroo” ". qala wasammanee qala " naʿam ". fabaka.

title: 'My wealth, my wealth'
narrator: Mutarrif reported on the authority of his father:
en: I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was reciting:" Abundance diverts you" (cii. 1). He said: The son of Adam claims: My wealth, my wealth. And he (the Prophet) said: O son of Adam. is there anything as your belonging except that which you consumed, which you utilised, or which you wore and then it was worn out or you gave as charity and sent it forward?
ar:
‏ يَقُولُ ابْنُ آدَمَ مَالِي مَالِي
- قَالَ - وَهَلْ لَكَ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ مِنْ مَالِكَ إِلاَّ مَا أَكَلْتَ فَأَفْنَيْتَ أَوْ لَبِسْتَ فَأَبْلَيْتَ أَوْ تَصَدَّقْتَ
فَأَمْضَيْتَ ‏
note: Only what you eat, wear or give away truly belongs to you.
tl: Yaqoolu ibnu adama mal-y mal-y - qala - wahal laka ya ibna adama min mal-ka ila ma akalta faafnayta aw labista faablayta aw tasaddaqta faamdayta

title: Al-Kawthar: a river in Paradise
en: One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sitting amongst us that he dozed off. He then raised his head smilingly. We said: What makes you smile. Messenger of Allah? He said: A Sura has just been revealed to me, and then recited: In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful. Verily We have given you Kauthar (fount of abundance). Therefore turn to your Lord for prayer and offer sacrifice, and surely your enemy is cut off (from the good). Then he (the Prophet) said: Do you know what Kauthar is? We said: Allah and His Messenger know best. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: It (Kauthar) is a canal which my Lord, the Exalted and Glorious has promised me, and there is an abundance of good in it. It is a cistern and my people would come to it on the Day of Resurrection, and tumblers there would be equal to the number of stars. A servant would be turned away from (among the people gathered there). Upon this I would say: My Lord, he is one of my people, and He (the Lord) would say: You do not know that he innovated new things (in Islam) after you. Ibn Hujr made this addition in the hadith:" He (the Prophet) was sitting amongst us in the mosque, and He (Allah) said: (You don't know) what he innovated after you"
ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُخْتَارُ بْنُ فُلْفُلٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، ح
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الْمُخْتَارِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ بَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِنَا إِذْ أَغْفَى إِغْفَاءَةً ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مُتَبَسِّمًا فَقُلْنَا مَا أَضْحَكَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَىَّ آنِفًا سُورَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَرَأَ ‏"‏ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ‏{‏ إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ * فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَانْحَرْ * إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الأَبْتَرُ‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَدْرُونَ مَا الْكَوْثَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهُ نَهْرٌ وَعَدَنِيهِ رَبِّي عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَيْهِ خَيْرٌ كَثِيرٌ هُوَ حَوْضٌ تَرِدُ عَلَيْهِ أُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ آنِيَتُهُ عَدَدُ النُّجُومِ فَيُخْتَلَجُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْهُمْ فَأَقُولُ رَبِّ إِنَّهُ مِنْ أُمَّتِي ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ مَا تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثَتْ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ حُجْرٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِنَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَحْدَثَ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
note: The Prophet ﷺ smiled as this surah was revealed.
tl: Haddathana ʿaliyyu bnu hujrin as-saʿdiyyu, haddathana ʿaliyyu bnu mushirin, akhbarana al-mukhtaru bnu fulfulin, ʿan anasi bni mal-kin, h wahaddathana aboo bakri bnu abee shaybata, - wal-lafzu lahu - haddathana ʿaliyyu bnu mushirin, ʿani al-mukhtari, ʿan anasin, qala bayna rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama dhata yawmin bayna azhurina idh aghfa ighfa'atan thumma rafaʿa ra'sahu mutabassiman faqulna ma adhakaka ya rasoola Allahi qala " unzilat ʿala anifan sooratun ". faqara'a " bismi Allahi ar-rahmani ar-raheemi “ inna aʿtaynaka al-kawthara * fasalli lirabbika wanhar * inna shani'aka huwa al-abtaru” ". thumma qala " atadroona ma al-kawtharu ". faqulna Allahu warasooluhu aʿlamu. qala " fainnahu nahrun waʿadaneehi rabbee ʿazza wajalla ʿalayhi khayrun katheerun huwa hawdun taridu ʿalayhi ummatee yawma al-qiyamati aniyatuhu ʿadadu an-nujoomi fayukhtalaju al-ʿabdu minhum faaqoolu rabbi innahu min ummatee. fayaqoolu ma tadree ma ahdathat baʿdaka ". zada ibnu hujrin fee hadeethihi bayna azhurina fee al-masjidi. waqala " ma ahdatha baʿdaka ".

title: The two surahs of the Fajr sunnah
narrator: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited in the two (supererogatory) rak'ahs of the dawn (prayer):
en: " Say: O unbelievers," (Qur'an, cix.) and" Say: Allah is one" (cxii.).
ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، - هُوَ ابْنُ كَيْسَانَ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَرَأَ فِي رَكْعَتَىِ الْفَجْرِ ‏{‏ قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ‏}‏ وَ ‏{‏ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏
note: Al-Kafirun and Al-Ikhlas in the two units before Fajr.
tl: Haddathanee muhammadu bnu ʿabbadin, wabnu abee ʿumara, qal- haddathana marwanu bnu muʿawiyata, ʿan yazeeda, - huwa ibnu kaysana - ʿan abee hazimin, ʿan abee hurayrata, anna rasoola Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama qara'a fee rakʿata al-fajri “ qul ya ayyuha al-kafiroona” wa “ qul huwa Allahu ahadun”

title: An-Nasr announced the Prophet's ﷺ passing
en: `Umar used to make me sit with the elderly men who had fought in the Battle of Badr. Some of them felt it (did not like that) and said to `Umar "Why do you bring in this boy to sit with us while we have sons like him?" `Umar replied, "Because of what you know of his position (i.e. his religious knowledge.)" One day `Umar called me and made me sit in the gathering of those people; and I think that he called me just to show them. (my religious knowledge). `Umar then asked them (in my presence). "What do you say about the interpretation of the Statement of Allah: 'When comes Help of Allah (to you O, Muhammad against your enemies) and the conquest (of Mecca).' (110:1) Some of them said, "We are ordered to praise Allah and ask for His forgiveness when Allah's Help and the conquest (of Mecca) comes to us." Some others kept quiet and did not say anything. On that, `Umar asked me, "Do you say the same, O Ibn `Abbas?" I replied, "No." He said, 'What do you say then?" I replied, "That is the sign of the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  which Allah informed him of. Allah said:-- '(O Muhammad) When comes the Help of Allah (to you against your enemies) and the conquest (of Mecca) (which is the sign of your death). You should celebrate the praises of your Lord and ask for His Forgiveness, and He is the One Who accepts the repentance and forgives.' (110:3) On that `Umar said, "I do not know anything about it other than what you have said."
ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ عُمَرُ يُدْخِلُنِي مَعَ أَشْيَاخِ بَدْرٍ، فَكَأَنَّ بَعْضَهُمْ وَجَدَ فِي نَفْسِهِ فَقَالَ لِمَ تُدْخِلُ هَذَا مَعَنَا وَلَنَا أَبْنَاءٌ مِثْلُهُ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ إِنَّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ عَلِمْتُمْ‏.‏ فَدَعَا ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ ـ فَأَدْخَلَهُ مَعَهُمْ ـ فَمَا رُئِيتُ أَنَّهُ دَعَانِي يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلاَّ لِيُرِيَهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا تَقُولُونَ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ‏}‏ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ أُمِرْنَا نَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ، إِذَا نُصِرْنَا وَفُتِحَ عَلَيْنَا‏.‏ وَسَكَتَ بَعْضُهُمْ فَلَمْ يَقُلْ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ لِي أَكَذَاكَ تَقُولُ يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا تَقُولُ قُلْتُ هُوَ أَجَلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْلَمَهُ لَهُ، قَالَ ‏{‏إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ‏}‏ وَذَلِكَ عَلاَمَةُ أَجَلِكَ ‏{‏فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا‏}‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ مَا أَعْلَمُ مِنْهَا إِلاَّ مَا تَقُولُ‏.‏
note: Ibn 'Abbas's deep understanding of this short surah.
tl: Haddathana moosa bnu ismaʿeela, haddathana aboo ʿawanata, ʿan abee bishrin, ʿan saʿeedi bni jubayrin, ʿani ibni ʿabbasin, qala kana ʿumaru yudkhilunee maʿa ashyakhi badrin, faka'anna baʿdahum wajada fee nafsihi faqala lima tudkhilu hadha maʿana walana abna'un mithluhu faqala ʿumaru innahu min haythu ʿalimtum. fadaʿa dhata yawmin faadkhalahu maʿahum fama ru'eetu annahu daʿanee yawma'idhin ila liyuriyahum. qala ma taqooloona fee qawli Allahi taʿal-a “idha ja'a nasru Allahi wal-fathu” faqala baʿduhum umirna nahmadu Allaha wanastaghfiruhu, idha nusirna wafutiha ʿalayna. wasakata baʿduhum falam yaqul shay'an faqala lee akadhaka taqoolu ya ibna ʿabbasin faqultu la. qala fama taqoolu qultu huwa ajalu rasooli Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama aʿlamahu lahu, qala “idha ja'a nasru Allahi wal-fathu” wadhalika ʿalamatu ajalika “fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wastaghfirhu innahu kana tawwaban”. faqala ʿumaru ma aʿlamu minha ila ma taqoolu.

title: Abu Lahab's curse
en: When the Verse:-- 'And warn your tribe of near kindred.' (26:214) was revealed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  went out, and when he had ascended As-Safa mountain, he shouted, "O Sabahah!" The people said, "Who is that?" "Then they gathered around him, whereupon he said, "Do you see? If I inform you that cavalrymen are proceeding up the side of this mountain, will you believe me?" They said, "We have never heard you telling a lie." Then he said, "I am a plain warner to you of a coming severe punishment." Abu Lahab said, "May you perish! You gathered us only for this reason? " Then Abu Lahab went away. So the "Surat:--ul--LAHAB" 'Perish the hands of Abu Lahab!' (111:1) was revealed.
ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏ وَرَهْطَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ، خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى صَعِدَ الصَّفَا فَهَتَفَ ‏"‏ يَا صَبَاحَاهْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا مَنْ هَذَا، فَاجْتَمَعُوا إِلَيْهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَخْبَرْتُكُمْ أَنَّ خَيْلاً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ سَفْحِ هَذَا الْجَبَلِ أَكُنْتُمْ مُصَدِّقِيَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا مَا جَرَّبْنَا عَلَيْكَ كَذِبًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي نَذِيرٌ لَكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ تَبًّا لَكَ مَا جَمَعْتَنَا إِلاَّ لِهَذَا ثُمَّ قَامَ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ‏}‏ وَقَدْ تَبَّ هَكَذَا قَرَأَهَا الأَعْمَشُ يَوْمَئِذٍ‏.‏
note: The cause of revelation of Surah Al-Masad.
tl: Haddathana yoosufu bnu moosa, haddathana aboo usamata, haddathana al-aʿmashu, haddathana ʿamroo bnu murrata, ʿan saʿeedi bni jubayrin, ʿani ibni ʿabbasin radiya Allahu ʿanhuma qala lamma nazalat “waandhir ʿasheerataka al-aqrabeena” warahtaka minhumu al-mukhlaseena, kharaja rasoolu Allahi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama hatta saʿida as-safa fahatafa " ya sabahah ". faqal-wa man hadha, fajtamaʿoo ilayhi. faqala " ara'aytum in akhbartukum anna khaylan takhruju min safhi hadha al-jabali akuntum musaddiqiyya ". qal-wa ma jarrabna ʿalayka kadhiban. qala " fainnee nadheerun lakum bayna yada ʿadhabin shadeedin ". qala aboo lahabin tabban laka ma jamaʿtana ila lihadha thumma qama fanazalat “tabbat yada abee lahabin watabba” waqad tabba hakadha qara'aha al-aʿmashu yawma'idhin.

title: Equal to a third of the Quran
en: A man heard another man reciting (Surat-Al-Ikhlas) 'Say He is Allah, (the) One.' (112. 1) repeatedly. The next morning he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  and informed him about it as if he thought that it was not enough to recite. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)  said, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, this Surah is equal to one-third of the Qur'an!"
ar: ‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّهَا لَتَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏
note: The virtue of Surah Al-Ikhlas.
tl: Walladhee nafsee biyadihi innaha lataʿdilu thulutha al-qur'ani

title: 'Tell him that Allah loves him'
en: The Prophet (ﷺ) sent (an army unit) under the command of a man who used to lead his companions in the prayers and would finish his recitation with (the Sura 112): 'Say (O Muhammad): "He is Allah, the One." ' (112:1) When they returned (from the battle), they mentioned that to the Prophet. He said (to them), "Ask him why he does so." They asked him and he said, "I do so because it mentions the qualities of the Beneficent and I love to recite it (in my prayer)." The Prophet; said (to them), "Tell him that Allah loves him."
ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا الرِّجَالِ، مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانَتْ فِي حَجْرِ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ رَجُلاً عَلَى سَرِيَّةٍ، وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ لأَصْحَابِهِ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَيَخْتِمُ بِ ـ ‏{‏قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏ فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوا ذَكَرُوا ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سَلُوهُ لأَىِّ شَىْءٍ يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَأَلُوهُ فَقَالَ لأَنَّهَا صِفَةُ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ بِهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَخْبِرُوهُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
note: A man loved Al-Ikhlas because it describes the Most Merciful.
tl: Haddathana ahmadu bnu sal-hin, haddathana ibnu wahbin, haddathana ʿamrun, ʿani ibni abee hilalin, anna aba ar-rijali, muhammada bna ʿabdi ar-rahmani haddathahu ʿan ummihi, ʿamrata binti ʿabdi ar-rahmani wakanat fee hajri ʿa'ishata zawji an-nabiyyi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama ʿan ʿa'ishata anna an-nabiyya salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama baʿatha rajulan ʿala sariyyatin, wakana yaqra'u l'ashabihi fee salatihi fayakhtimu bi “qul huwa Allahu ahadun” falamma rajaʿoo dhakaroo dhalika lin-nabiyyi salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama faqala " saloohu l'a sha'in yasnaʿu dhalika ". fasa'aloohu faqala l'annaha sifatu ar-rahmani, waana uhibbu an aqra'a biha. faqala an-nabiyyu salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama " akhbiroohu anna Allaha yuhibbuhu ".

title: Verses like no others
narrator: 'Uqba b. 'Amir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:
en: What wonderful verses have been sent down today. the like of which has never been seen! They are:" Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the dawn," and" Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of men."
ar: ‏ أَلَمْ تَرَ آيَاتٍ أُنْزِلَتِ اللَّيْلَةَ لَمْ يُرَ مِثْلُهُنَّ قَطُّ ‏{‏ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ‏}‏ وَ ‏{‏ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ‏}‏ ‏
note: The two surahs of seeking refuge.
tl: Alam tara ayatin unzilati al-laylata lam yura mithluhunna qattu “ qul aʿoodhu birabbi al-falaqi” wa “ qul aʿoodhu birabbi an-nasi”

title: The Prophet's ﷺ bedtime recitation
en: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to bed every night, he used to cup his hands together and blow over it after reciting Surat Al-Ikhlas, Surat Al-Falaq and Surat An-Nas, and then rub his hands over whatever parts of his body he was able to rub, starting with his head, face and front of his body. He used to do that three times.
ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُفَضَّلُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ جَمَعَ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ نَفَثَ فِيهِمَا فَقَرَأَ فِيهِمَا ‏{‏قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏ وَ‏{‏قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ‏}‏ وَ‏{‏قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ‏}‏ ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقْبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ‏.‏
note: Blowing into the hands after reciting the last three surahs.
tl: Haddathana qutaybatu bnu saʿeedin, haddathana al-mufaddalu, ʿan ʿuqaylin, ʿani ibni shihabin, ʿan ʿurwata, ʿan ʿa'ishata, anna an-nabiyya salla Allahu ʿalayhi wasallama kana idha awa ila firashihi kulla laylatin jamaʿa kaffayhi thumma nafatha feehima faqara'a feehima “qul huwa Allahu ahadun” wa“qul aʿoodhu birabbi al-falaqi” wa“qul aʿoodhu birabbi an-nasi” thumma yamsahu bihima ma istataʿa min jasadihi yabda'u bihima ʿala ra'sihi wawajhihi wama aqbala min jasadihi yafʿalu dhalika thalatha marratin.
